summary_en.technical_approach: Presents HierFlow architecture, decomposes workflow generation into a coupled process of upper-layer topology search (defining subtask boundaries) and lower-layer execution search (optimizing sub-workflows); upper layer adopts feedback-guided dynamic topology adjustment, lower layer adopts MCTS-inspired fast tree search, adds an intelligent gating module to selectively trigger execution-level search based on context for overhead reduction.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract is truncated; only confirms the gating module effectively reduces search overhead and improves overall efficiency, specific quantitative metrics are not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 纯Agent工作流搜索的工程方法，与LLM基座预训练核心环节无直接关联，仅作领域常识了解即可。
recommendation.en: Pure engineering method for agent workflow search, no direct relevance to core LLM foundation pretraining links, only for domain common sense understanding.

paper.title: The Regression Tax: Decomposing Why Skills Help and Hurt LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Adding procedural skills to an LLM agent is typically evaluated by average improvement in task success. However, this metric hides an important cost: skills can also make agents worse. We measure both sides by comparing agents with and without skills across nearly 6,000 runs spanning two office automation benchmarks and three model harness stacks. This allows us to distinguish two outcomes. A regression is a task solved without skills but failed after skills are added. A residual failure is a ta

summary.core_problem: 给 LLM Agent 添加 procedural skills 后，平均成功率可能上升，但会掩盖一类重要失败：原本能做对的任务被技能上下文弄错。
summary.importance: 这是 Agent 行为分析工作，贡献在于把 skill 带来的收益拆成新增成功和回归失败，并指出技能并非单调增益。对预训练研究的间接价值在于提醒：上下文中的工具/技能描述会改变模型策略分布，即使没有被调用。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较带技能和不带技能的 Agent，在同一任务上定义两类失败：regression 是无技能能成功、有技能反而失败；residual failure 是两者都失败。进一步归纳三类回归机制：skill description osmosis、grounding displacement、verification disruption。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖约 6000 次运行、两个 office automation benchmark、三个模型 harness stack。摘要给出的主要结论是，表现最好的 skills 主要是因为造成的 regression 更少，而不是带来更多新增成功；未给出具体模型名称和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Adding procedural skills to LLM agents can improve average success while hiding regressions where tasks solved without skills fail after skills are added.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent behavior analysis paper. Its main contribution is decomposing skill effects into new wins and regressions, showing that skills are not monotonic improvements. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that tool and skill descriptions in context can shift policy behavior even when unused.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares agents with and without skills on matched tasks, defining regressions as tasks solved without skills but failed with skills, and residual failures as tasks failed in both settings. It identifies three mechanisms: skill description osmosis, grounding displacement, and verification disruption.
summary_en.experiments: The study reports roughly 6,000 runs across two office automation benchmarks and three model harness stacks. The headline result is that stronger skills mainly outperform by causing fewer regressions, not by producing more new gains; the abstract does not provide exact model names or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和回归分解即可；它把“多塞技能总有益”这个 Agent prior 打松了，但还不是基座训练证据。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and regression decomposition; it usefully weakens the ‘more skills always help’ prior, but it is not pretraining evidence.

paper.title: ArbiGraph: Arbitrarily Scalable Verifiable Task Graphs for Evaluating Context Management
paper.abstract: We introduce ARBIGRAPH, a benchmark generator for evaluating whether tool-assisted language agents can retain, update, compose, and discard task-relevant context across extended reasoning workflows. ARBIGRAPH represents each task as a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver, and composes tasks through typed intermediate states, instantiated here as scalar and list values. This design enables controllable task graphs whose length, dependency structure, distractor count, and valu

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent评测难以精确控制任务复杂度与依赖结构，无法系统评估LLM在长推理工作流中的上下文管理能力。
summary.importance: 提出首个可任意扩展、可自动验证的任务图benchmark生成器，可系统评测上下文管理的不同维度，属于评测方法与工具创新。
summary.technical_approach: 将每个任务表示为带可执行Python求解器的自然语言问题，通过类型化中间状态（标量、列表）组合成任务图，可灵活调整任务长度、依赖结构、干扰项数量、值类型，通过执行求解器实现精确自动验证。
summary.experiments: 用数学、GSM应用题、Python追踪三类任务实例化，在四种拓扑结构上评测Qwen3.5-27B工具辅助Agent，发现分支依赖的数学任务上准确率最多下降33.3%，单任务评测无法暴露这类缺陷。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含Gennady Pekhimenko（多伦多大学，ML系统与高效计算方向）、Mark C. Jeffrey（多伦多大学，计算机系统方向）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks cannot precisely control task complexity and dependency structure, making it hard to systematically evaluate LLMs' context management abilities in extended reasoning workflows.
summary_en.importance: First arbitrarily scalable, automatically verifiable task graph benchmark generator for systematic evaluation of context management dimensions; represents evaluation methodology and tool innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each task is a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver; tasks are composed via typed intermediate states (scalars, lists) into task graphs with adjustable length, dependency structure, distractor count, and value type, enabling exact automatic verification via solver execution.
summary_en.experiments: Instantiated with math, GSM-style word problems, and Python tracing tasks; evaluates Qwen3.5-27B tool-assisted agent across four topologies, finding up to 33.3% accuracy drop on branching dependent math tasks — failures not exposed by single-task benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Gennady Pekhimenko (University of Toronto, ML systems and efficient computing) and Mark C. Jeffrey (University of Toronto, computer systems).

recommendation.zh: 可控任务图评测上下文管理能力，设计干净，预训练研究员可参考其评测范式验证模型长上下文依赖能力，重点看§3任务构造。
recommendation.en: Cleanly designed controllable task graph benchmark for context management; pretraining researchers can reference its paradigm to test long-context dependency abilities, focus on §3 task construction.

paper.title: The Dark Room in the Reward Channel: Dense Prediction Rewards Collapse GRPO-Trained LLM Agents -- and What Actually Works
paper.abstract: Dense per-step supervision is an appealing remedy for sparse-reward, long-horizon LLM agents: reward the agent for predicting its next observation, and memory should follow. We show that under group-normalized RL (GRPO), this recipe does not merely fail -- it destroys the policy. Across Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B on ALFWorld, a potential-based prediction reward drives every run into a degenerate absorbing state (prediction accuracy -> 1.0, task success -> 0,episode length pinned at the horizon): the "dark

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是：在长程 LLM agent 的 GRPO 训练中，把“预测下一步观察”作为 dense reward，为什么会让策略坍缩到可预测但无任务进展的状态。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的启发在于，它把 reward 设计问题推进到 advantage estimator 层面。一个 episode-level 有界、看似安全的 shaping reward，经过 GRPO 的 group std normalization 后，会在全失败组里被放大成完整训练压力。这对 RL-for-reasoning、agent RL、过程奖励设计都有警示：reward 的绝对量级不够，必须看它在分组采样、归一化和失败分布下的方差结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者在 ALFWorld 多步环境中让模型每步输出一个可验证的 <predict> block，预测下一 observation 的任务无关特征，例如位置、可见物体、容器状态。预测奖励以 potential difference 形式注入，每步缩放系数 λ=0.1，episode 总和会 telescoping 到一个有界项，因此从 return 角度看扰动很小。但在 GRPO 中，组内 advantage 会除以本组标准差。稀疏成功奖励导致 all-fail groups 很常见，这时组内唯一差异来自很小的预测 shaping 项；std normalization 会把这个小差异标准化到完整尺度，使 λ 的缩小失效。论文用 Proposition 1 解释这种 λ-invariance，并进一步提出 variance-profile criterion：危险不取决于 dense signal 的大小或密度，而取决于模型掌握该信号后，组内方差是否仍然存在。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B，在 ALFWorld 上以相同配置训练：group size 4，训练 batch 为 8×4=32 trajectories/step，验证 32 episodes，采样温度 0.4。加入预测奖励后，所有规模都出现相同轨迹：初期看似改善，随后转向，最终进入吸收态；prediction accuracy 到 1.0，task success 到 0，episode length 固定在 horizon。单因素消融显示，只移除 GRPO 的 std normalization，就能把同一 reward 从 0% collapse 恢复到约 51.6% success，接近 baseline。信号通道实验显示，把同样内容作为 reward channel 基本中性或有害，而作为 auxiliary loss 可带来约 20 个百分点收益；shuffled-gold placebo 表明精确的内容-上下文配对不是主要有效因素。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 failure chain 的描述，再看 Proposition 1 和 Proposition 2，重点理解 all-fail group、std normalization、λ-invariance 三者的连接。实验部分优先看 collapse 曲线、去掉 std normalization 的单因素 rescue，以及 signal-delivery matrix。对做 RL post-training 的读者，最有用的是 variance-profile criterion 和 early-warning diagnostics；环境细节和 synthetic POMDP 可以按需浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why a dense next-observation prediction reward, intended to help long-horizon LLM agents with sparse task rewards, can collapse GRPO training into a predictable but task-useless policy.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson is at the interface between reward design and the advantage estimator. A shaping reward can be bounded at the episode-return level and still become destructive after group-wise standard-deviation normalization. This matters for RL training of reasoning models and agents: reward scale alone is not a safety knob. The relevant object is the reward signal’s within-group variance under the sampler, especially in all-fail groups where sparse success rewards provide no variation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup asks the agent to emit a verifiable <predict> block at each step in ALFWorld. The prediction targets task-agnostic features of the next observation, such as location, visible objects, and receptacle state. The reward is implemented as a potential difference with coefficient λ=0.1, so the episode-level sum telescopes to a bounded term. The failure arises inside GRPO. Because sparse terminal rewards create many all-fail groups, the only within-group return differences are the small dense prediction terms. GRPO then divides by the group standard deviation, turning those small differences into full-scale normalized advantages. Proposition 1 formalizes the resulting λ-invariance: reducing the shaping coefficient does not reduce the update in such groups, unless the coefficient is set to zero. Proposition 2 reframes the issue as a variance-profile criterion: a dense signal is dangerous when its within-group variance survives after the model has mastered it.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments train Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B agents on ALFWorld with group size 4, 8 groups per update, 32 trajectories per training step, 32 validation episodes, and sampling temperature 0.4. With the prediction reward, all tested scales follow the same pattern: an initial honeymoon phase, a turn, and then an absorbing state with prediction accuracy reaching 1.0, task success dropping to 0, and episode length pinned at the horizon. A single-factor ablation localizes the cause: removing only GRPO’s standard-deviation normalization changes the same reward from 0% success to about 51.6%, roughly baseline parity. The delivery-channel experiments are also informative. Reward-channel variants are neutral or harmful, while delivering similar information through an auxiliary loss improves success by about 20 points. A shuffled-gold placebo suggests that exact content-context pairing is not the main active ingredient.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the Introduction for the failure chain, then focus on Proposition 1 and Proposition 2 to understand why bounded shaping can become large after z-scoring. In the experiments, prioritize the collapse curves, the ablation that removes standard-deviation normalization, and the signal-delivery matrix. For RL post-training work, the variance-profile criterion and early-warning diagnostics are the most reusable pieces. The synthetic POMDP and feature-coverage analysis are useful if one wants a more controlled account of when prediction-style signals fail.

recommendation.zh: GRPO稠密奖励崩溃的机制扎实且普适，做RL后训练或mid-train RL的人必须注意这个归一化坑，可直接复现验证避坑
recommendation.en: The mechanism of GRPO collapse with dense rewards is solid and generalizable; anyone doing RL post-training or mid-train RL must note this normalization pitfall

paper.title: PerfAgent: Profiler-Guided Iterative Refinement for Repository-Level Code Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents now perform well on correctness-oriented repository-level tasks, including SWE-Bench issue resolution and feature implementation in real codebases. However, they still struggle with repository-level code optimization, which requires preserving behavior while improving runtime performance. Passing tests is not enough in this setting; a patch must preserve behavior, implement code optimization, and approach expert speedups. Current agents often miss bottlenecks hi

summary.core_problem: 现有面向正确性的代码LLM Agent在仓库级代码优化任务上表现不佳，存在瓶颈定位不准、过早停止优化、测试不充分三类核心失败模式，无法达到人类专家的优化水平。
summary.importance: 明确了代码Agent在性能优化任务上的能力缺口主要来自反馈质量而非生成能力，其profiler引导、验证器在环的迭代工作流设计，对代码模型的后训练反馈信号设计、测试时计算的高效分配有参考价值，也为多维度反馈的工具增强Agent设计提供了可复用思路。
summary.technical_approach: PerfAgent是构建在通用代码Agent之上的工作流，包含三个核心组件对应三类失败模式：一是整理采样性能分析器的热点信息（位置、调用上下文、运行时占比）反馈给Agent，辅助定位跨抽象层/原生扩展的瓶颈；二是目标驱动的循环控制器，不接受首个通过测试的补丁，强制Agent多轮迭代优化，保留多轮中最快的正确补丁；三是选择性测试，仅运行受当前补丁影响的测试用例，以低成本捕获正确性回归。
summary.experiments: 在GSO和SWE-fficiency-Lite两个仓库级代码优化基准上测试：使用GPT-5.1作为基座时，达到人类专家水平的补丁比例在GSO上提升2倍（39.2% vs 基线19.6%），在SWE-fficiency-Lite上提升2.8倍（74% vs 26%）；使用开源模型Kimi-K2时，两个基准上均提升1.5倍。其效果优于oracle best-of-five基线，但计算成本远低于后者，说明提升来自更好的反馈而非更多测试时计算。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第1章的失败模式分析与PerfAgent核心设计思路，快速浏览第2章的基准设置，方法实现章节可按需查看具体的profiler集成与循环控制逻辑。预计阅读时间30-40分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Correctness-focused code LLM agents perform poorly on repository-level code optimization, limited by three core failure modes — inaccurate bottleneck localization, premature optimization termination, and insufficient testing — and cannot match human expert performance.
summary_en.importance: It clarifies that the performance gap of code agents on optimization tasks comes more from feedback quality than raw generation capability. Its profiler-guided, verifier-in-the-loop iterative workflow design provides reference for post-training feedback signal design for code models and efficient test-time compute allocation, and offers reusable ideas for building tool-augmented agents with multi-dimensional feedback.
summary_en.technical_approach: PerfAgent is a workflow layered on top of off-the-shelf coding agents, with three components targeting the identified failure modes: 1) A curated profiler summary that extracts hotspot information (location, call context, runtime share) from a sampling profiler and feeds it to the agent to help localize bottlenecks across abstraction layers or in native extensions. 2) An objective-driven loop controller that rejects the first passing patch, forces iterative optimization, and retains the fastest correct patch across multiple attempts. 3) Selective testing that only runs test cases affected by the current patch to catch correctness regressions at low cost.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on two repository-level code optimization benchmarks, GSO and SWE-fficiency-Lite. With GPT-5.1 as the base model, the fraction of expert-matching patches increases by 2× on GSO (39.2% vs. 19.6% baseline) and 2.8× on SWE-fficiency-Lite (74% vs. 26% baseline). With the open-source Kimi-K2 model, it delivers a 1.5× improvement on both benchmarks. PerfAgent also outperforms an oracle best-of-five baseline at a fraction of the compute cost, confirming gains come from better feedback rather than more test-time compute.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 for the three failure mode analysis and high-level PerfAgent design. Skim Section 2 for benchmark setup details. Method implementation sections can be read selectively for details on profiler integration or loop control logic. Estimated reading time: 30–40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 Profiler 引入 Coding Agent 的反馈循环，解决仓库级代码优化难题，思路清晰且实用，对构建更强大的软件工程 Agent 有直接参考价值。
recommendation.en: Integrating a profiler into the feedback loop of a coding agent to tackle repository-level code optimization is a clear and practical approach, offering direct value for building stronger SWE agents.

paper.title: RAIL Guard: Closing the Evaluation-to-Remediation Gap in Responsible AI for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Existing guardrail systems for large language model agents operate as binary classifiers that block unsafe content, leaving organizations to discard failing outputs and retry from scratch. We introduce RAIL Guard, a closed-loop responsible AI pipeline that evaluates LLM outputs across eight measurable dimensions and iteratively remediates failing outputs through an evaluate-rewrite-reevaluate loop. We evaluate the pipeline across three experiments on four frontier LLMs and 4,276 content outputs

summary.core_problem: 缩小 LLM agent 安全评估与实际修复之间的断层：不仅判断输出是否违规，还要在闭环中自动修复并复检。
summary.importance: 这是后训练/对齐侧的系统工作。它的价值在于把 guardrail 从二分类拦截扩展为 evaluate-rewrite-reevaluate 闭环，并区分哪些安全维度可通过反馈修复、哪些更像结构性失败。对研究训练信号质量和 self-repair 的人有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 RAIL Guard，对 LLM 输出按八个可测维度进行评估；若失败，则进入重写与再评估循环。系统同时覆盖普通文本输出和 agent tool-call 场景，并比较 block-and-retry、反馈驱动自修复等策略。核心思想不是训练新模型，而是把评估器和重写器串成闭环 remediation pipeline。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 4 个前沿 LLM、4276 条内容输出和 6400 个 agent tool-call 场景。闭环修复的收敛率为 96.9%，显著高于 block-and-retry 的 49.1%；但最高收敛方案带来 22.3% 的 utility 损失。反馈驱动 self-repair 在可修复维度上达到 86.6% 收敛，且无显著效用损失；tool-call 前评估使不安全执行下降 33%。
summary.authors_note: Responsible AI Labs 的工作，偏应用化安全工程，不是主流顶级实验室的基础方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap between evaluating unsafe LLM-agent outputs and actually remediating them in a closed loop rather than simply blocking and retrying.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/alignment systems paper. Its main value is extending guardrails from binary filtering to an evaluate-rewrite-reevaluate loop, while distinguishing dimensions that are fixable through feedback from those that reflect deeper failures. That offers some signal for people interested in training-signal quality and self-repair.
summary_en.technical_approach: RAIL Guard scores outputs along eight measurable dimensions and, upon failure, runs an iterative rewrite and reevaluation loop. The system covers both standard text outputs and agent tool-call scenarios, comparing block-and-retry against feedback-driven self-repair. The contribution is a closed-loop remediation pipeline rather than a new pretrained model.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses 4 frontier LLMs, 4,276 content outputs, and 6,400 agent tool-call scenarios. Closed-loop remediation reaches 96.9% convergence versus 49.1% for block-and-retry, though the highest-convergence method incurs a 22.3% utility drop. Feedback-driven self-repair achieves 86.6% convergence on fixable dimensions with no significant utility loss, and pre-tool-call evaluation reduces unsafe executions by 33%.
summary_en.authors_note: From Responsible AI Labs. This is more of an applied safety-engineering effort than a foundation-method paper from a major frontier lab.

recommendation.zh: 偏安全工程，不是基座研究主线；但“哪些维度可修、哪些只能拦”这个拆分有点用，读结果表即可，不必深挖方法细节。
recommendation.en: Mostly safety engineering rather than foundation work, but the split between fixable and non-fixable failure dimensions is worth noting; read the result tables, not the full method.

paper.title: Verify, Repair, Repeat, or Stop? Robust Stopping for Noisy Verify-Repair Loops in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Verify-repair loops are a standard means for large language model (LLM) agents to correct faulty plans in code generation, mathematical reasoning, and tool use. When both the verifier and the repairer are noisy, repair can damage already-correct plans, and reported acceptance keeps rising while true validity falls, so existing methods lack a principled basis for deciding when repair should stop. We propose VRR-Stop, a robust stopping framework for noisy verify-repair-repeat (VRR) loops. A four-p

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 的 verify-repair-repeat 循环在 verifier 和 repairer 都有噪声时，何时停止修复才不会越修越坏的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 agent/test-time refinement 的决策理论方法。它对预训练没有直接 recipe，但对推理时计算分配、verifier 质量、RLVR 和 agent 自修复循环都有参考价值，尤其指出“报告接受率上升”可能掩盖真实正确率下降。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VRR-Stop。方法用四参数噪声模型区分 verifier 的 false acceptance、false rejection，以及 repairer 的修复行为和破坏行为；用 belief filtering 将重复验证投票转成 committed validity 的估计；再根据真实边际收益的符号决定 commit 还是 repair。关键点是只要求 sign identifiability，不要求准确恢复所有噪声参数。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有列出具体 benchmark、模型规模或数值结果。它强调当 verifier discrimination 接近 0 时，校准会失败，估计误差会翻转停止决策；这给出了 verify-repair loop 的失效边界。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when an LLM agent should stop a verify-repair-repeat loop when both the verifier and the repairer are noisy.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a decision-theoretic method for general agent and test-time refinement loops. It is not a pretraining recipe, but it is relevant to inference-time compute allocation, verifier quality, RLVR-style pipelines, and self-repairing agents, especially because reported acceptance can rise while true validity falls.
summary_en.technical_approach: VRR-Stop uses a four-parameter noise model separating verifier false acceptance and false rejection from the repairer's repair and damage behavior. Belief filtering converts repeated verification votes into an estimate of committed validity, and the loop commits or repairs according to the sign of the true marginal gain. The method relies on sign identifiability rather than accurate recovery of all parameters.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or numerical results. It highlights a failure regime: when verifier discrimination approaches zero, calibration fails and estimation error can flip the stopping decision.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫公式和 stopping rule；它提醒 RLVR/agent loop 里 verifier AUC 比 repair 次数更像硬约束。
recommendation.en: Skim the equations and stopping rule; it usefully frames verifier discrimination, not repair count, as the hard constraint in RLVR-like loops.

paper.title: When Model Merging Rivals Joint Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning: A Task-Vector Geometry Analysis
paper.abstract: Model merging is promoted as a substitute for joint multi-task training, yet in the reinforcement-learning setting this substitution is essentially never tested against the baseline it claims to replace: methods merge independently released agents precisely because a joint model is unavailable. We build the missing comparison. Training difficulty-1 and difficulty-2 Qwen3-8B specialists on the AppWorld agent benchmark with LOOP, we merge them (TIES, RAM+) and pit the result against a jointly trai

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的问题很明确：在强化学习训练的 agent 场景里，model merging 常被当作 joint multi-task RL 的替代方案，但几乎没人把它和真正可得的 joint training baseline 正面比较。作者在一个可控设定里补上了这个缺口：当多任务数据其实可以合并训练时，合并两个 RL specialist 得到的 merged model，和直接在任务并集上做 joint RL，到底谁更好；如果两者差不多，原因是什么。论文进一步把问题落到 task-vector geometry 上，试图用参数空间中的方向关系解释“为什么 merge 方法差别不大”。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练的直接距离较远，因为主体是 post-training / RL agent，而不是 pretrain。但有两点仍有启发。第一，它提供了一个很干净的负结果：在 LoRA RL specialist 的这个 regime 里，merge 与 joint RL 在主指标上打平，说明很多关于 merge rule 设计的收益，可能先被任务噪声和向量几何结构淹没。第二，它把 task vector 的“支持重叠”和“方向近正交”区分开来，这对理解参数高维空间中的任务干扰、adapter 叠加、continual finetuning 乃至多域 mid-training 都有参考价值。贡献类型更像是受控比较和诊断分析，而不是提出新方法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者构造了一个尽量公平的比较框架。所有模型都从同一个 Qwen3-8B base 出发，用相同 LoRA 配置、相同 RL recipe、相同 benchmark。训练三个核心对象：difficulty-1 specialist、difficulty-2 specialist，以及在两类任务并集上训练的 joint model。然后把两个 specialist 的 task vector 做 merge，主要测试 TIES 和 RAM+ 这类方法。

论文的技术重点不在 merge 算法本身，而在几何诊断。因为所有 specialist 都用相同 LoRA target modules，所以 task vectors 的 support 是天然重合的；这排除了“因为更新位置不同所以不冲突”的简单解释。作者转而测量方向几何，尤其是 task vector cosine similarity，并做了 floor/ceiling calibration，避免把“低秩 LoRA 导致余弦小”误判为真正的任务解耦。结果显示两个 specialist 的 task vectors 虽然 support overlap 很大，但方向接近正交，cosine 只有 0.06–0.10。作者据此解释：既然共享子空间中的冲突分量本来就很小，那么 TIES 这类按符号或支持做 disentangle 的 merge 规则，自然没有太大发挥空间。

RL 训练方面，虽然名义上使用 LOOP，实际由于算力限制采用的是 on-policy、单次更新、无 rollout reuse 的配置，因此等价于 RLOO/REINFORCE with leave-one-out baseline。这个细节很重要，因为它说明实验中的 specialist 不是强 PPO-style off-policy RL 产物，而是较轻量的 on-policy policy gradient 结果。也就是说，结论适用的 regime 更接近“LoRA + 轻量 RL 调整”的 agent specialization，而不是大规模深度 RL。
summary.experiments:
核心实验结论很集中。作者在 AppWorld 上训练两个 specialist 和一个 joint model，并在 168 个 held-out test_normal 任务上比较 task-goal completion。结果是：所有 merge 变体与 joint RL 在 TGC 上统计上不可区分，真正显著的提升只来自“做了 RL”相对于 base model，而不是“用哪种多任务整合方式”。这意味着在 8B、约 10 次 RL iterations、任务难度差距只有 1–2 档的设定下，merge 与 joint 的差异落在噪声墙之下。

几何分析给出更细的解释：specialist task vectors 的 cosine 约为 0.06–0.10，接近正交；而且这种小的共享分量是在训练过程中逐步形成的，不是初始化或 LoRA 低秩约束的假象。作者还强调 support overlap 很大，因此“近正交”不是因为更新模块不同。

论文还报告了一个值得谨慎看待的现象：如果换成连续 partial-credit metric，merged models 会低于未合并模型，似乎显示 merge 有损。但作者进一步说明，这个差异并不代表 joint/merge 产生了新的跨任务能力，也不能通过 trajectory-aware checkpoint selection 弥补；而且该指标与 TGC 的排序会反转，说明结论对 metric 很敏感。这个部分的价值在于提醒读者：agent RL 里评测指标的分辨率和噪声结构，会直接决定你能否看见 merge/joint 的真实差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓三处。第一，看实验设定部分，确认比较是否公平：同一 base、同一 LoRA、同一 RL recipe、同一数据预算。第二，看主结果表和统计检验，重点不是均值谁高一点，而是作者如何证明“不可区分”。第三，看 task-vector geometry 分析，尤其是 cosine 的定义、校准方法、以及 support overlap 与 direction orthogonality 的区分。若时间有限，可以略过 merge 方法细节推导，因为论文的主要信息不是提出新 merge rule，而是说明在这个 regime 下 rule 之间没有可见差异。预计 25–35 分钟能读完主线；若想把它和参数高维干扰问题联系起来，再细看 §5.2、§5.3 和关于 checkpoint selection 无效的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a missing baseline question in RL model merging: when joint multi-task RL is actually feasible, does merging independently trained RL specialists match a jointly trained model, and if so, why? Most prior merging work in agent settings studies the case where a joint model is unavailable, so the claimed substitute is rarely compared against the thing it is supposed to replace. The authors build a controlled comparison and then use task-vector geometry to explain the outcome.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant at the interface between parameter-space adaptation, continual specialization, and post-training. Its main value is a careful null result. In this LoRA-based RL regime, merging matches joint multi-task RL on the primary metric, and different merge rules are statistically indistinguishable. That is useful because it suggests that, before attributing gains to sophisticated merge heuristics, one should check whether the task vectors are already geometrically non-interfering. The paper also makes a useful distinction between support overlap and directional overlap, which matters for thinking about adapter composition, multi-domain tuning, and interference analysis more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is designed to be as controlled as possible. All models start from the same Qwen3-8B base, use the same LoRA configuration, the same RL recipe, and the same benchmark. The authors train two specialists on AppWorld subsets split by difficulty level, plus a joint model trained on the union of those tasks. They then merge the two specialists using standard methods such as TIES and RAM+.

The technical center of the paper is not a new merge rule but a geometric diagnosis of why merge method barely matters here. Because all specialists adapt the same LoRA target modules, their task vectors have overlapping support by construction. This rules out the trivial explanation that they simply modify disjoint parameters. The authors therefore measure directional geometry, especially cosine similarity between task vectors, and calibrate the measurement with floor and ceiling references so that small cosine values cannot be dismissed as a low-rank LoRA artifact. The key finding is that the specialists’ task vectors are nearly orthogonal, with cosine around 0.06–0.10, despite large support overlap. If the conflicting shared component is already tiny, then support-aware or sign-aware merge rules have little left to disentangle.

A notable implementation detail is that, although the paper frames training in terms of LOOP, the actual compute-constrained regime is on-policy with one update per rollout batch and no rollout reuse. In effect, this reduces to RLOO / REINFORCE with a leave-one-out baseline rather than a stronger PPO-style off-policy variant. That matters for interpreting the scope of the result: it is about LoRA specialists produced by relatively lightweight RL, not deeply optimized large-scale RL agents.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is simple. On AppWorld, the authors compare two specialists, their merges, and a joint model on 168 held-out test_normal tasks using task-goal completion. All merge variants and the joint model are statistically indistinguishable on TGC. The only clear gain is RL over the base model. In other words, at 8B scale, with roughly 10 RL iterations and only a 1–2 difficulty margin between task groups, the merge-vs-joint differences sit below the noise floor.

The geometry analysis provides the explanation. The specialists’ task vectors have cosine similarity around 0.06–0.10, i.e. close to orthogonal, and the paper argues that this is not an artifact of low-rank LoRA. At the same time, support overlap is large because the same modules are adapted. So the vectors overlap in where they act, but not much in the directions they push.

The paper also reports a metric-sensitivity result. Under a continuous partial-credit metric, merged models look worse than the unmerged ones. The authors caution against over-interpreting this: the ranking can reverse relative to TGC, the effect does not indicate emergent cross-task capability, and trajectory-aware checkpoint selection does not recover the gap. This is a useful reminder that in agent RL, the apparent difference between merge and joint training can depend heavily on the evaluation metric’s resolution and noise properties.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper with three focal points. First, verify the fairness of the setup: same base model, same LoRA targets, same RL recipe, same data budget. Second, read the main results table and the statistical testing carefully; the point is not tiny mean differences but the claim of indistinguishability. Third, spend time on the task-vector geometry section, especially how cosine is measured, how the floor/ceiling calibration is done, and why support overlap does not imply directional interference. You can safely skim the merge-rule details unless you specifically care about TIES or RAM+, because the paper’s main contribution is the controlled comparison and the diagnosis, not a new algorithm. About 25–35 minutes should be enough for the main line.

recommendation.zh: 读 task-vector 几何和 joint RL 对照即可；若 setup 干净，内部多任务 RL 合并实验应复现这个基线。
recommendation.en: Read the task-vector geometry and joint-RL comparison; if the setup is clean, this baseline should be replicated in internal multitask RL merging tests.

paper.title: SkillCorpus: Consolidating and Evaluating the Open Skill Ecosystem for Real-World LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Agent skills, SKILL.md files that package reusable procedural knowledge for an LLM agent, are a popular mechanism for extending agent capabilities. Public repositories now host them in large and growing numbers, yet these artifacts are fragmented, redundant, and uneven in quality, and their value in practice is unclear. A core question remains open, namely how to consolidate this open-source SKILL.md ecosystem into a single usable corpus, and what bounds its benefit on real-world agent tasks. We

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是开放 SKILL.md 生态如何变成可用 agent 资产的问题。公开仓库里已经有大量技能文件，但来源分散、重复严重、质量不稳定、许可不清晰，也缺少对真实 agent 任务收益的系统测量。SkillCorpus 的目标不是提出新的 agent 策略，而是把这些外部化的过程知识整理成一个可检索、可分发、可评测的技能语料库。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 post-train 与 agent 能力扩展接口有启发。它把“能力写入权重”之外的另一条路径做成了可测量对象：冻结模型通过检索外部技能获得过程知识。对预训练研究员来说，主要信息增益在三点：第一，开放技能生态中重复率和噪声很高，直接拿来做训练或检索会污染信号；第二，技能质量需要拆成 utility、specificity、actionability 等可操作维度，而不是单一分数；第三，agent 能力提升不仅取决于模型，也取决于外部知识组织、匹配和 harness 的耦合方式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个完整的数据工程和评测流水线。作者从 62 个来源入口抓取约 821,000 个 raw SKILL.md 文件，来源包括直接克隆仓库、awesome-list、marketplace API、sitemap crawl 和 JSON catalog。经过仓库级去重后，25,159 个 GitHub 仓库进入六阶段处理：结构解析、长度与格式过滤、去重、LLM judge 质量与安全打分、OSI permissive 许可过滤、检索嵌入与索引构建。去重是核心环节：先用内容和名称 fingerprint 做精确去重，再用 1024 维 embedding 做语义去重，cosine 大于 0.995 的 pair 自动合并，0.90 以上的边界样本交给 LLM judge 判定。和只从单一来源收集技能的工作不同，SkillCorpus 更像一个面向 agent 技能的 Common Crawl 清洗版，同时提供匹配模型和端到端评测。
summary.experiments: 论文报告从约 821,000 个 raw skills 中筛出 96,401 个开放许可技能。去重阶段从 283,844 个候选压到 101,111 个，减少 64%。其中精确重复有 169,465 个，占该阶段输入的 59.7%，说明公开技能生态存在大量复制传播。语义去重阶段发现 66,751 个边界 pair，LLM judge 确认其中 25.4% 为近重复，并合并 13,268 个技能。下游评测覆盖三个真实 agent benchmark、多个 harness，以及从开源到 frontier 的模型骨干。结论是 SkillCorpus 集成后能稳定提升 agent 表现，但收益受语料覆盖和 harness 设计影响；论文没有把技能库描述成通用解法，而是强调不同任务域的收益差异。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。优先看 Figure 1 和 §3.1–§3.4，理解抓取、过滤、去重、质量打分、检索匹配的流水线。重点看去重数字和质量 facet 设计，这部分对构建训练数据、RAG 语料或 agent memory 都有参考价值。§4 可以快速看实验设置和 per-domain 结果，关注哪些任务因为技能覆盖不足而收益有限。Appendix A.6 适合需要复现数据采集的人看。无需精读 agent benchmark 细节，除非关心技能检索如何接入具体 harness。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a data and infrastructure problem for skill-augmented agents: public SKILL.md files are abundant, but fragmented, duplicated, noisy, and often unclear in licensing. SkillCorpus tries to turn this open ecosystem into a usable corpus and then measure whether such a corpus actually helps agents on real tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not central to foundation-model pretraining, but it is useful for understanding the boundary between model weights and external procedural knowledge. It gives evidence that agent capability can be improved through curated, retrievable skills, but only when the corpus is deduplicated, quality-gated, license-audited, and matched well to the task. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is about data quality: raw community artifacts contain heavy duplication and uneven procedural value, so using them directly for training or retrieval would produce noisy supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillCorpus is an end-to-end aggregation, curation, retrieval, and evaluation pipeline. The crawl starts from 62 registered sources and uses multiple ingestion mechanisms, including cloned repositories, awesome-list scraping, marketplace APIs, sitemap crawling, and JSON catalogs. Around 821,000 raw SKILL.md files are collected. After repository-level filtering, 25,159 GitHub repositories enter a six-stage pipeline: structural parsing, length and format filtering, deduplication, LLM-judge quality and safety scoring, OSI-permissive license filtering, and embedding/index construction. Deduplication combines exact fingerprints with semantic embedding matching. Pairs above cosine 0.995 are merged automatically, while borderline pairs above 0.90 are adjudicated by an LLM judge. The system also trains a retrieval-and-selection stack for matching skills to tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The released corpus contains 96,401 skills curated from roughly 821,000 raw files. Deduplication is the largest reduction step, shrinking 283,844 candidates to 101,111, a 64% reduction. Exact matching collapses 169,465 duplicates, or 59.7% of the stage input. Semantic matching produces 66,751 borderline pairs; the LLM judge confirms 25.4% as near-duplicates and merges 13,268 skills. End-to-end evaluations span three real-world agent benchmarks, independent harnesses, and model backbones ranging from open models to frontier systems. The reported pattern is consistent improvement from SkillCorpus integration, with gains depending on corpus coverage and the agent harness.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on Figure 1 and Sections 3.1–3.4 for the data pipeline, deduplication strategy, quality facets, and retrieval stack. The deduplication statistics are the most transferable part for anyone building training corpora or retrieval assets from community data. Section 4 is useful for understanding when external skills help and when coverage or harness design limits the gains. Appendix A.6 is worth checking if source coverage and crawl reproducibility matter.

recommendation.zh: 读数据过滤和 retrieval ablation；它像 Agent 版数据配方，结论别外推到预训练但可借鉴质检维度。
recommendation.en: Read the filtering pipeline and retrieval ablations; it is an agent-data recipe, not a pretraining result, but the quality facets are reusable.

paper.title: When Do Multi-Agent Systems Help? An Information Bottleneck Perspective
paper.abstract: LLM powered multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a promising paradigm for complex tasks. However, their advantages over single-agent systems (SAS) remain unclear, with performance varying inconsistently across settings. Here, we provide an information bottleneck perspective on elucidating the differences between MAS and SAS. Specifically, our key observation is that a SAS accumulates its full reasoning trace in one shared context, while a MAS uses isolated local contexts connected by bounde

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论多智能体系统什么时候比单智能体系统有用。核心问题不是“多几个 agent 是否更强”，而是上下文如何被组织、压缩和传递：单智能体把所有推理轨迹放进同一个上下文，多智能体把局部上下文隔离开，再通过有限长度的 relay message 传信息。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接价值有限，但对 agent 训练、长上下文使用、上下文压缩和推理时信息流设计有启发。论文给出一个清晰判断：如果中间消息能去掉上游噪声，同时保留下游需要的信息，多智能体会有收益；如果 relay 丢掉了关键状态或约束，强模型尤其容易受损。这解释了为什么一些实验里 MAS 的收益随基座模型能力提升而缩小，甚至变负。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 agentic task 建模为部分可观测序列决策过程，并把 SAS 与 MAS 放进同一套 basic-agent 抽象里。关键论证是无限通信带宽下的等价性：MAS 可以把完整上游上下文传给下游 agent，从而精确模拟 SAS。因此 MAS 的非平凡差异来自有限 relay 带宽，而不是任务拆分本身。作者随后把每个 relay 看成信息瓶颈：relay 压缩上游上下文，一方面减少无关历史对下游决策的干扰，另一方面会造成不可恢复的信息损失。模型能力被放进一个有效参数 β 中；β 越高，表示下游模型越能利用完整上下文，也越可能被 relay 的信息损失伤害。
summary.experiments: 实验设计重点是区分“任务拆分”和“上下文隔离/压缩”。作者比较 SAS、SAS-contextflow 和 MAS 三种设置，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、WorkBench、WideSearch、TravelPlanner 五个 agentic benchmark 上做 18 组比较，覆盖 Qwen2.5-7B、GPT-4o-mini、Qwen3.5-27B 三个模型尺度。主要现象是：当 relay 信息接近充分时，MAS 相比 SAS-contextflow 更稳定地受益；当 relay 丢失下游相关信息时，收益缩小或反转；强模型对 relay 信息损失更敏感。这个结果支持论文的阶段式 MAS gain 分解：上下文降噪收益需要大于能力加权后的 relay loss。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 的 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解作者把 MAS 收益归因到 relay compression 的视角。再看 Problem Setup 中的 MAS–SAS equivalence，这是全文最关键的形式化结论。实验部分重点看三种系统设置的对照方式，以及不同模型尺度下 gain 如何变化。若关注 agent 训练或长上下文压缩，可以细看 relay sufficiency、β 参数和失败案例；若只关注预训练 recipe，可以跳过大部分 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when LLM-based multi-agent systems actually help over a single-agent system. Its main point is that the difference is not the number of agents alone, but the information topology: a single agent accumulates all reasoning traces in one shared context, while a multi-agent system isolates local contexts and connects them through bounded relay messages.
summary_en.importance: The work is only indirectly relevant to base-model pretraining, but it is useful for reasoning about agent training, long-context usage, and inference-time context compression. The useful takeaway is concrete: multi-agent decomposition helps when relay messages remove distracting upstream context while preserving downstream-relevant information. It hurts when the relay drops constraints, observations, or intermediate state that later workers cannot reconstruct. This also gives a plausible explanation for why MAS gains often shrink as the base model becomes stronger.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize agentic tasks as partially observable sequential decision processes and define SAS and MAS under a shared agent abstraction. The central theoretical result is an infinite-bandwidth equivalence: if each relay can transmit the full upstream context, a MAS can exactly simulate a SAS. Therefore, any nontrivial MAS gain or loss must come from bounded relay compression. Each relay is then modeled as an information bottleneck. Compression reduces downstream interference from irrelevant context, but it also introduces information loss. An effective parameter β represents downstream model capability; larger β makes the system more sensitive to lost task-relevant information.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical design separates decomposition from context isolation by comparing SAS, SAS-contextflow, and MAS variants. The study reports 18 comparisons across ALFWorld, WebShop, WorkBench, WideSearch, and TravelPlanner, using Qwen2.5-7B, GPT-4o-mini, and Qwen3.5-27B. The main pattern is consistent with the theory: MAS improves over SAS-contextflow when relay messages are nearly sufficient, but gains diminish or become negative when relays lose downstream-relevant information. Stronger models appear less helped by compression and more exposed to relay loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with Figures 1 and 2 to understand the compression-versus-loss framing. Then read the MAS–SAS equivalence argument in the problem setup; it is the key conceptual contribution. In the experiments, focus on how the three system variants isolate relay compression from task decomposition, and on how the gain changes with model scale. Readers interested in agentic long-context design should spend extra time on the relay sufficiency analysis and failure regimes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看形式化部分；它把“多 Agent 是否有用”还原成上下文压缩问题，比堆角色提示更干净。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the formalization: it reduces multi-agent gains to context compression, a cleaner lens than role-prompt folklore.

paper.title: Memory as a Controlled Process: Learned Adaptive Memory Management for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory systems to accumulate experience across tasks. Yet nearly all existing approaches, from graph-structured memories to reflective insight stores, access memory through fixed, hand-designed heuristics. We argue that this static view of memory is a core bottleneck for agentic learning because optimal memory behavior is fundamentally context-dependent. The early stages of the tasks, benefit from minimal retrieval because memory is

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“如何设计一种新记忆库”，而是更基础的一层：LLM agent 在长期任务流里，什么时候该取记忆、取哪一类记忆、取多少、失败后是否重取、以及记忆库何时该压缩和遗忘。现有方法大多把这些决策写成固定启发式，例如固定 top-k、固定查询模板、固定图跳数，或者把控制权直接交给另一个 LLM。前者在任务阶段、记忆规模、任务熟悉度变化时会失配；后者虽然自适应，但每次记忆操作都要额外付出一次 LLM 调用。论文要解决的核心问题，是能否用一个足够轻量、在线可学、与后端解耦的控制层，把 memory access 从静态流程改成上下文相关的决策过程，而且不增加额外 LLM 调用。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，这篇论文不是直接改训练目标或数据配比的工作；它更接近 pretrain-posttrain 接口上的系统研究。但它有两个值得注意的启发。第一，agent 能力里“外部记忆如何被调用”本身就是一个可学习控制问题，而不是存储结构设计完就结束。第二，它把一类常见的 agent 提升来源拆开了：有些收益并不来自更强的 base model，也不来自更大的 memory store，而来自更好的检索时机与操作选择。这对研究长期上下文、检索增强预训练、测试时适应、甚至 latent memory/episodic memory 训练目标都有参考意义。贡献量级上，它更像一个工程上很干净的控制层抽象：不改后端、不加 LLM call、可在线更新，适合作为 agent memory 系统的默认增强件，而不是一种新的基础建模范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把 memory management 写成一个顺序决策问题。论文定义了一个 Memory MDP：状态同时编码任务进展和记忆状态，前者包括 goal type、当前 step phase、是否卡住、访问过的位置等，后者包括 memory size、是否已有可复用 plan、当前处于学习早期还是后期等。动作不是单一“retrieve”，而是一组带参数的 memory operation，包括 Retrieve、PlanInject、Re-Retrieve、Consolidate、Forget、NoOp，以及对应的 top_k、insight_k、graph hop 等参数选择。

控制策略没有用神经网络，也没有再训练一个小模型，而是用了 tabular contextual bandit + UCB exploration。这样做的原因很明确：一是在线部署时样本很少，二是状态特征是人工可解释的离散上下文，三是希望毫秒级决策而不是引入新的推理链路。策略从 human-readable priors warm start，而不是冷启动随机探索；任务结束后用 binary success 做反向折扣式 credit assignment，把一次任务成功或失败分摊给先前做过的 memory decisions。这个设计不追求严格的长期 credit 最优，而是追求在几十个任务内就能学到比固定启发式更稳的控制。

论文还强调它是 backend-agnostic wrapper。也就是说，MemCon 不定义新的存储格式，而是在 retrieve/store 抽象接口上做拦截和调度，因此可以套在 flat vector store、skill library、trajectory summary、graph memory、latent-token memory 等不同后端上。这个抽象是方法里最干净的部分，因为它把“存什么”和“怎么调用”分开了。

另外两个增强操作值得注意。PlanInject 面向重复 goal type，不再只做相似轨迹检索，而是优先注入抽象化、对象泛化后的成功计划模板；Re-Retrieve 面向 stuck 状态，当 agent 连续重复动作或无进展时，不是重复读同一批 top-k，而是换查询重检索。Consolidate 和 Forget 则处理长任务流中的记忆膨胀问题，避免 memory store 规模增长后把噪声一并带进 prompt。相比 MemGPT 这类让 LLM 自己当控制器的方案，MemCon 的区别不在记忆表达，而在把控制逻辑外置成一个廉价、可持续学习的策略层。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖面比较广：6 个 benchmark，既有交互式决策环境，也有知识/网页/工具使用问答；3 个 agent framework；3 个 LLM backbone；9 个 memory baseline。文中点名的环境包括 ALFWorld、PDDL planning、ScienceWorld、TriviaQA、WebWalkerQA、GAIA；框架包括 Lobster、LangGraph、Microsoft Agent Framework；骨干模型包括 GPT-4.1-mini、Claude Sonnet-4、DeepSeek-V3.2。

主结果是：MemCon 在大多数配置下达到最好或接近最好任务成功率，同时平均 token 消耗下降 5% 到 20%。论文在引言里给出的代表性数字是，GPT-4.1-mini + Lobster + ALFWorld 这一格上做到 67.9% success，在该设置下 10 种 memory 系统里最高；相对 no-memory baseline，多个设置上能带来 5 到 30+ 个点的成功率提升。这个结果说明它不是只在某一种 memory backend 上有效，而是控制层本身就能稳定带来收益。

更关键的是消融。论文专门做了 component ablation 来隔离 learned controller 的贡献，目的是回答“提升到底来自更复杂的 memory operation，还是来自学到的调度策略”。从作者叙述看，结论是两者都有，但 learned controller 是主要增益来源之一，尤其在任务早期少检索、重复任务 plan reuse、卡住时 re-retrieval 这几类情形下最明显。另一个重要观察是收敛速度：策略在几十个任务内就能学到有用行为，不需要预训练控制器。这一点和它采用 contextual bandit 而不是更重的 RL 方案是一致的。

如果从实验可信度看，优点是横向覆盖广、后端种类多、模型和框架都换了；局限是奖励信号比较粗，只用 task success，因而 credit assignment 的精细度有限。对于复杂长程任务，某些 memory action 的真实价值可能被终局成败掩盖。论文更像证明“轻量在线控制足够有用”，而不是已经把 memory policy 学到了最优。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三处。第一是方法部分对 Memory MDP 的定义，重点看 state 和 action 空间是怎么离散化的；这决定了它为什么能用表格 bandit 而不是神经策略。第二是 backend-agnostic wrapper 的接口设计，弄清楚它到底改了什么、没改什么。第三是实验里的 component ablation，尤其是 learned controller 对比 fixed heuristic 的部分，这一块最能判断方法是否只是“多加了几个操作”。

如果时间有限，建议先看 Figure 1 和方法总览，再看主表和消融表，最后回到 credit assignment 与 warm-start priors 的细节。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。值得留意的深挖点有两个：一是 reverse-discounted credit assignment 是否会在长任务上引入系统性偏差；二是状态特征工程的可迁移性，换环境后是否需要重新手工设计 stuck indicator、goal type 等上下文变量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about inventing a new memory store. It targets a more basic layer: how an LLM agent should decide when to retrieve memory, what kind of memory to retrieve, how much to retrieve, whether to re-retrieve after getting stuck, and when to consolidate or forget old memory. Most prior systems hard-code these choices with fixed heuristics such as one retrieval per step, one query template, one top-k, or one graph-hop depth. The alternative line, exemplified by MemGPT-style designs, lets an LLM act as the controller, but that adds an extra model call for each memory operation. The core problem here is whether memory access can be turned into a lightweight, online-learned, backend-agnostic control process without adding any extra LLM calls.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. It sits closer to the pretrain–posttrain interface and agent systems. Still, it carries two useful lessons for foundation-model researchers. First, external memory is not only a storage design problem; it is also a control problem. Second, some gains often attributed to stronger models or richer memory stores may actually come from better timing and better choice of memory operations. That matters for retrieval-augmented training, test-time adaptation, long-context modeling, and learned episodic memory. The contribution is best understood as a clean systems abstraction: a reusable control layer that can sit on top of many memory backends, rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method formulates memory management as a sequential decision problem. The paper defines a Memory MDP whose state combines task-progress signals and memory-status signals. Task-side features include goal type, step phase, whether the agent is stuck, and visited locations. Memory-side features include memory size, whether reusable plans already exist, and the current learning phase. Actions are not limited to a generic retrieve call. The action space includes Retrieve, PlanInject, Re-Retrieve, Consolidate, Forget, and NoOp, together with operation parameters such as top_k, insight_k, and graph-hop depth.

The policy is intentionally simple: a tabular contextual bandit with UCB exploration. The choice is pragmatic. Online deployment offers limited samples, the context variables are interpretable and mostly discrete, and the controller must run in milliseconds. The policy is warm-started with human-readable priors instead of random exploration. After each task, binary task success is propagated backward through a reverse-discounted credit assignment scheme so earlier memory decisions receive partial credit or blame. This is not trying to solve full long-horizon RL optimally; it is trying to learn a useful controller within tens of tasks.

A key design point is backend agnosticism. MemCon does not define a new storage format. It wraps the abstract retrieve/store interface and decides how the backend should be called. That means the same controller can sit on top of flat vector stores, skill libraries, trajectory summaries, graph memories, and latent-token memories. This separation between what is stored and how it is accessed is one of the cleanest aspects of the paper.

Two augmented operations are especially relevant. PlanInject is used for recurring goal types: instead of nearest-neighbor retrieval over raw trajectories, it injects a distilled and object-generalized plan template from prior successful episodes. Re-Retrieve is triggered when the agent appears stuck, so the system issues an alternative query rather than re-reading the same failed top-k results. Consolidate and Forget address memory growth over long task streams, aiming to prevent prompt dilution and retrieval noise. Compared with LLM-as-controller approaches, the novelty is not in memory representation but in externalizing control into a cheap, persistent, online-learned policy layer.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is broad: 6 benchmarks, 3 agent frameworks, 3 LLM backbones, and 9 memory baselines. The environments named in the paper include ALFWorld, PDDL planning, ScienceWorld, TriviaQA, WebWalkerQA, and GAIA. The frameworks include Lobster, LangGraph, and Microsoft Agent Framework. The backbones include GPT-4.1-mini, Claude Sonnet-4, and DeepSeek-V3.2.

The main result is that MemCon achieves the best or near-best task success in most settings while also reducing average token usage by 5% to 20%. A representative number highlighted early in the paper is 67.9% success on ALFWorld with GPT-4.1-mini under the Lobster framework, the top score among the 10 memory systems compared in that cell. Relative to a no-memory baseline, the gains are often in the 5 to 30+ point range. That matters because the improvement appears across different backends, suggesting the controller itself contributes meaningful value.

The ablations are more important than the headline table. The paper isolates the contribution of the learned controller from the contribution of simply adding more memory operations. The reported pattern is that both matter, but the learned policy is a major source of gains, especially in three regimes: retrieving less in early tasks, preferring plan reuse for recurring goals, and triggering alternative retrieval when the agent is stuck. Another notable result is convergence speed: the controller learns useful behavior within tens of tasks, without any pretraining. That aligns with the choice of a contextual bandit rather than a heavier RL setup.

In terms of evidence quality, the strengths are breadth and backend diversity. The main limitation is the reward signal: task success is binary and coarse. For long-horizon tasks, the true value of individual memory actions may be obscured by final success or failure. So the paper demonstrates that lightweight online control is useful, not that the learned policy is close to optimal.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the Memory MDP definition carefully, especially how the state and action spaces are discretized; that explains why a tabular bandit is sufficient. Second, inspect the backend-agnostic wrapper design to see exactly what is changed and what is left untouched. Third, go to the component ablations that compare the learned controller against fixed heuristics; that is where the paper earns its claim.

If time is limited, start with Figure 1 and the method overview, then read the main results table and the ablation section, and only after that return to the details of warm-start priors and reverse-discounted credit assignment. A useful skim should take around 25 to 35 minutes. Two deeper questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the reverse-discounted credit scheme introduces bias on long tasks, and how portable the hand-designed context features are across environments.

recommendation.zh: 把“记忆检索配方”改成可学习控制是对agent系统的实质推进；先核查训练信号与对比是否干净，再决定要不要复现。
recommendation.en: Turning memory heuristics into a learned control policy is a real step forward; first verify the training signal and baseline cleanliness before investing in reproduction.

paper.title: Can Induced Emotion Bias LLM Behaviors in Sequential Decision Making?
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in high-stakes domains, understanding contextual factors that may modulate their decision-making becomes critical. While LLMs are trained to perceive and resonate with users' emotions, it remains unclear whether induced emotion can influence their sequential decision-making. We investigate this question using the Iowa Gambling Task (IGT), a classic psychological paradigm for studying decision-making under uncertainty,

summary.core_problem: 研究情绪诱导是否会改变 LLM agent 在连续决策任务中的行为轨迹。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是行为机制分析。它把心理学中的 Iowa Gambling Task 引入 LLM agent 研究，用来区分模型是否只是识别情绪，还是会让情绪上下文进入后续决策策略。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用基于想象的情绪诱导流程，在上下文中诱发不同情绪，再让模型执行 IGT 连续选择任务。方法上先验证模型能从上下文中感知可区分的强情绪，并能在交互中以类似人类的速度学习，然后比较不同诱导情绪下的决策动态。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕 IGT 序列决策展开，主要测量不同情绪条件下的平均决策变化和条件性效应。摘要给出的核心结果是：与人类不同，诱导情绪平均而言不会显著改变 LLM agent 的决策动态；但愤怒条件存在依赖上下文或模型状态的条件性影响。具体模型列表、样本量和显著性表格在给定信息中未披露。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 MBZUAI、Texas A&M University、National University of Singapore、UCLA、University of Texas at Austin、Mass General Hospital；Zhangyang Wang 在高效模型、视觉与大模型相关研究中有较高可见度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether induced emotions can bias LLM agents during sequential decision making.
summary_en.importance: This is a behavioral mechanism study. It imports the Iowa Gambling Task into LLM-agent analysis to separate emotional recognition from downstream decision-policy changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors combine an imagination-based emotion induction procedure with the Iowa Gambling Task. They first check that models can perceive distinct emotional contexts and learn from sequential interactions, then compare decision dynamics under different induced emotions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on sequential choices in IGT-style interaction. The main reported finding is that induced emotion does not significantly shift average LLM-agent decision dynamics, unlike typical human findings, while anger has conditional effects. The supplied abstract does not specify the model roster, sample sizes, or exact statistical tables.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliations include MBZUAI, Texas A&M University, National University of Singapore, UCLA, the University of Texas at Austin, and Mass General Hospital. Zhangyang Wang is a visible researcher in efficient models, vision, and large-model research.

recommendation.zh: 可扫摘要和结果表；它更像 agent 行为测量，能提醒别把情绪对齐能力误读成策略层情绪偏置。
recommendation.en: Skim the setup and results tables; it is mainly an agent-behavior probe, useful for not conflating emotion recognition with policy-level emotional bias.

paper.title: Who&When Pro: Can LLMs Really Attribute Failures in AI Agents?
paper.abstract: Automated failure attribution uses LLMs to identify where and why agentic systems fail. As agents become more capable, their failures become subtler, making automated attribution increasingly important. We introduce Who&When Pro, a large-scale benchmark for automated failure attribution in agentic systems. Using a strictly controlled pipeline that injects a failure only after exactly replaying a successful prefix, we construct 12,326 failed trajectories with golden labels across 3 modalities and

summary.core_problem: 现有AI Agent自动失败归因基准仅覆盖文本模态、规模极小（仅184条），且缺乏高质量自动标注的失败轨迹，无法支撑多模态、复杂场景下Agent失败归因能力的评测与研究。
summary.importance: 1）提供大规模多模态失败归因基准，可用于训练和评测具备自我错误诊断能力的Agent基座模型；2）可控错误注入的轨迹构造方法可迁移用于合成预训练/RL阶段的自我改进信号；3）揭示的跨模态、跨协议归因规律为Agent对齐训练的目标设计提供实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1）提出可扩展的自动数据构造管线：先在26个基准、15种Agent框架上生成成功轨迹，再选定步骤注入6类（感知/推理/规划/行动/验证/协同）可控错误，从该步热启动生成失败续篇，注入错误直接作为金标决定性错误；2）构建Who&When Pro基准，覆盖文本、图像、视频3模态、9类任务；3）设计跨模态、跨协议、跨模型家族的归因行为分析框架。
summary.experiments: 基准包含12326条带金标的失败轨迹；实验发现视频模态的错误步骤定位难度最高，多模态轨迹为失败模式诊断提供更强线索；全轨迹归因协议显著优于增量式归因；开源模型作为归因骨干具备不错的性价比表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先级：第3节基准构造管线（重点3.3错误注入流程）→第4节核心实证规律与统计结论，附录可按需查看失败分类体系和基准明细；预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing automated failure attribution benchmarks for AI agents are restricted to text-only modalities, contain only 184 small-scale instances, and lack high-quality automatically annotated failure trajectories, making them unsuitable for evaluating and researching agent failure attribution in multimodal, complex real-world scenarios.
summary_en.importance: 1) Delivers a large-scale multimodal failure attribution benchmark that supports training and evaluation of agent base models with self-error diagnosis capabilities; 2) The controlled error injection trajectory construction pipeline can be transferred to synthesize self-improvement signals for pretraining or RL stages; 3) Revealed cross-modal and cross-protocol attribution patterns provide empirical guidance for agent alignment training objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Introduces a scalable automatic data construction pipeline: first roll out successful trajectories across 26 benchmarks and 15 agent frameworks, then inject 6 categories of controlled errors (perception/reasoning/planning/action/verification/coordination) at selected steps, and warm-start execution from that step to generate failed continuations, with the injected error directly used as the golden decisive error label; 2) Builds the Who&When Pro benchmark covering 3 modalities (text, image, video) and 9 task categories; 3) Designs an analysis framework for attribution behavior across modalities, protocols, and model families.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 12,326 failure trajectories with golden labels. Key findings include: step localization is particularly challenging for video modality traces; multimodal traces provide stronger cues for failure mode diagnosis; full-trajectory attribution protocols significantly outperform incremental protocols; open-weight models deliver favorable cost-performance trade-offs as attribution backbones.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 3 (benchmark construction pipeline, focus on §3.3 error injection workflow) → Section 4 (core empirical patterns and statistical conclusions). Appendices can be reviewed on demand for failure taxonomy and benchmark details. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Agent失败归因基准，失败注入方法学严谨，对做Agent评测或调试系统的人有参考，看基准构造章节即可。
recommendation.en: Rigorously constructed agent failure attribution benchmark with clean failure injection methodology; useful for agent evaluation and debugging systems; read the benchmark construction section.

paper.title: Agentic Routing: The Harness-Native Data Flywheel
paper.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly executed not by a single model call, but by an execution harness that manages observation, context, control, action, state, and verification. At the same time, frontier and open models are becoming structurally specialized: a model that is strong at code editing, long-context recovery, tool use, mathematical reasoning, or low-latency response may not dominate on the other axes. This makes model selection inside an agent a core systems problem rather t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 agent 执行中的模型路由问题：路由不应只在用户请求级别选择一个模型，而应在 harness 的每个执行步骤里，根据状态、失败信号、成本和验证结果选择模型或模型组合。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更接近 agent 系统设计和数据闭环方案。它的启发在于把 agent harness 产生的执行轨迹视为训练数据：每一步的输入、状态、模型选择、执行结果、验证信号和成本都可以成为 router 或 specialist model 的监督信号。这对 post-train 数据构造、agent-native training、模型专长化有参考意义，但不是新的预训练目标或训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案是 Harness-Native agentic routing。传统 routing 多在单轮 query 上做成本—质量折中；作者把 routing 放到 agent harness 内部，作为 step-level control decision。路由器的条件不只是 prompt，还包括 observation、context、control state、action schema、历史失败、verification 结果和 runtime cost。部署上分两种模式：低成本模式选择一个当前步骤最合适的模型和可能的 harness 配置；高准确率模式选择多个互补模型，再通过 ensemble、verification、voting、debate 或 fallback 聚合输出。关键区别是：路由决策会改变后续轨迹，便宜模型在早期步骤的错误可能导致后续更高修复成本，因此目标是优化执行轨迹，而不是优化单次调用。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的内容主要是范式定义和系统设计论证，没有看到严格的 benchmark、消融或真实部署数字。可确认的结果形态是提出一个数据飞轮：step-level routing 产生结构化日志，日志包含 query、harness state、model choice/model set、execution trace、outcome 和 realized cost；这些记录再用于训练 router 和 harness-native specialist models。该工作目前更像设计框架，不应按有实证增益的方法论文来读。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 Agent = Base Models + Harness 的拆分，以及 Harness-Native routing 与 query-level routing 的区别。Figure 1 如果完整给出，应关注两种部署模式：cost-effective single-model routing 和 high-accuracy multi-model aggregation。对预训练研究员更有用的是数据飞轮部分：哪些 harness 信号可作为训练标签，哪些信号比人工偏好数据更接近真实执行环境。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes model routing for agents: routing should not be a per-query serving decision, but a step-level decision inside the execution harness, conditioned on state, failures, verification signals, cost, and downstream recovery risk.
summary_en.importance: Its direct contribution to foundation-model pretraining is limited. The useful angle is the data loop: an agent harness can turn each routing decision into structured supervision, including the input, harness state, chosen model or model set, trace, outcome, verification result, and realized cost. This is relevant to post-training data construction, agent-native training, and specialist-model development, but it is not a new pretraining objective or optimization recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed paradigm is Harness-Native agentic routing. Instead of selecting a model only from the user query, the router operates at each execution step and observes the harness state: observations, context, control flow, action schemas, state history, intermediate failures, verification results, and runtime accounting. The paper describes two deployment regimes. In the cost-effective regime, the router selects one best-fit model and possibly a harness configuration. In the high-accuracy regime, it selects a set of complementary models and combines them through ensemble, verification, voting, debate, or fallback policies. The main distinction from standard routing is trajectory dependence: a cheap choice at one step can create expensive recovery later, so the routing target is the execution path rather than a single completion.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content is mainly a conceptual and systems formulation. It does not present a rigorous benchmark, ablation study, or deployment-scale numerical result. The concrete artifact is the proposed logging and training loop: every step-level routing decision yields a structured record with query, harness state, model choice, execution trace, outcome, and cost, which can then train routers or harness-native specialist models. It should be read as a design proposal rather than an empirically validated method paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim read is enough, roughly 15–25 minutes. Focus on the Introduction, especially the shift from Agent = Model + Harness to Agent = Base Models + Harness, and the contrast between harness-native routing and query-level routing. If Figure 1 is available, inspect how the paper separates cost-effective single-model routing from high-accuracy multi-model aggregation. For pretraining researchers, the most useful part is the data flywheel: which execution signals can become training labels, and why they may be more grounded than static preference data.

recommendation.zh: 提出harness原生的step级agent路由思路，适配多模型专业化趋势，对预训练模型分工设计有参考，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Proposes harness-native step-level agent routing for specialized model ecosystems; useful for pre-training model specialization design, skim methodology.

paper.title: When Agents Remember Too Much: Memory Poisoning Attacks on Large Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Personal AI agents powered by large language models can reason and act using available tools to access emails, manage calendars, and push code to remote repositories, all with minimal oversight. When augmented with long-term memory, an agent can recall specific details relevant to the current task, reducing the need for large context windows. Currently, long-term memory agents tend to fall into two distinct domains: conversational and action-planning agents. Personal assistant agents sit at the

summary.core_problem: 指出带长期记忆的个人 LLM Agent 会把外部不可信内容写入记忆，从而形成可持久化、可延迟触发的攻击面。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 安全威胁建模。它把风险从普通 prompt injection 扩展到记忆子系统，尤其适用于会读邮件、管理日历、推送代码这类有工具权限的个人助手。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GhostWriter 攻击向量，分为 injection 和 activation 两阶段：攻击者先通过隐藏 payload 污染 Agent 的长期记忆；之后当 Agent 在相关任务中检索到这段记忆时，恶意指令被激活并影响工具调用或决策。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验平台、Agent 框架、模型、攻击成功率或防御基线。可确认的是论文聚焦 conversational memory 与 action-planning agent 交汇处的个人助手场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how long-term memory in personal LLM agents can be poisoned by untrusted external content and later activated during tool-using tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-security threat model. It extends the usual prompt-injection framing from transient context attacks to persistent memory corruption in personal assistants with sensitive tools.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces GhostWriter, a two-phase attack. During injection, an adversary sends a hidden payload that enters the agent's memory store. During activation, the poisoned memory is retrieved in a future task and steers the agent's behavior or tool calls.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the evaluated agent stack, models, success rates, or defense baselines. The stated scope is the intersection of conversational long-term memory and action-planning personal agents.

recommendation.zh: 不改预训练方法，但记忆污染这个 threat model 很干净；做 Agent memory 或 tool-use 的看攻击流程即可。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining, but the memory-poisoning threat model is clean; read the attack flow if you work on agent memory or tool use.

paper.title: Information Gain-based Rollout Policy Optimization: An Adaptive Tree-Structured Rollout Approach for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a promising paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon search tasks, where the agent must make a sequence of intermediate decisions before receiving a final outcome. However, existing methods still face a key limitation: the rollout budget is often allocated without explicitly assessing the utility of intermediate states. As a result, substantial computation may be spent on low-value states, even though different branches can vary d

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多轮检索型 LLM agent 的 rollout 预算分配问题。现有 RL 训练常把计算均匀或启发式地花在不同中间状态上，但许多前缀对最终答案没有帮助，导致长程搜索训练中的采样效率低。
summary.importance: 这属于 post-train / agent RL 方法，对基座预训练的间接启发在于训练信号质量和采样分布设计。它把 rollout collection 从“多采一些轨迹”改成“优先扩展能提高答案概率的中间状态”。这个思路可以迁移到更一般的推理训练：中间状态是否值得继续采样，应由它对目标答案或最终奖励的信息增量决定，而不是只由不确定性、随机分支或固定宽度决定。
summary.technical_approach: IGRPO 定义了一个操作化的信息增益：到达某个中间检索状态后，策略对 ground-truth answer 的归一化 likelihood 增加多少。rollout 不再沿单链生成，也不做简单均匀树扩展，而是在树结构中维护多个 active prefixes，并根据每个前缀的信息增益派生出的 informativeness 以概率选择扩展对象。高信息增益节点获得更多 rollout 预算，低信息增益节点仍可被采样但概率较低。作者还给出理论刻画：这种信息增益驱动的采样过程会诱导一个 limiting teacher distribution，策略优化目标可以看作向这个分布靠拢。相比 GRPO 只比较同题多条完整轨迹，IGRPO 更强调中间状态的价值评估；相比 Tree-GRPO 或 AEPO 这类树扩展方法，它用答案似然变化来组织扩展，而不是主要依赖随机或硬阈值规则。
summary.experiments: 实验在七个 search-augmented QA benchmark 上进行，使用 3B 和 7B backbone。结果显示，在相同 rollout budget 下，IGRPO 相比强基线平均提升 3.1%（3B）和 0.9%（7B）。这说明信息增益分配预算在小模型上收益更明显；7B 上提升较小，可能因为更强的初始策略减少了无效分支比例，也可能因为 likelihood-based 信息增益对强模型的区分度下降。提供内容未给出各数据集逐项分数、检索预算、树宽、最大轮数和训练 token 规模。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 40 分钟。重点看 information gain 的精确定义、树式 rollout 的采样规则、limiting teacher distribution 的理论部分，以及 3B/7B 在七个 QA benchmark 上的分项结果。若关注 RL for reasoning，可细读它如何把中间状态评分转成 rollout policy；若只关注预训练，可主要吸收“采样预算应跟训练信号信息量绑定”这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses rollout-budget allocation for multi-turn search agents trained with reinforcement learning. In long-horizon retrieval tasks, different intermediate states can have very different value for reaching the final answer, but existing methods often spend rollout computation uniformly or through coarse heuristics.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and agent-RL paper, with indirect relevance to pretraining research through the lens of sampling efficiency and training-signal quality. Its useful idea is to treat intermediate-state informativeness as the object that controls exploration. For reasoning-oriented training, this is a cleaner framing than simply increasing the number of rollouts or expanding a search tree with fixed-width or random branching.
summary_en.technical_approach: IGRPO defines information gain as the increase in the policy’s normalized likelihood of the ground-truth answer after reaching an intermediate search state. The rollout process is tree-structured: multiple active prefixes are maintained, and prefixes with higher information gain are selected for further expansion with higher probability. Low-informativeness branches are not necessarily discarded, but they consume less budget. The paper also characterizes the limiting distribution induced by this sampling process and interprets it as a teacher distribution for policy optimization. Relative to GRPO-style outcome comparison, the method uses intermediate states to guide data collection. Relative to existing tree-based rollout methods, it replaces random or threshold-based expansion with answer-likelihood information gain.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on seven search-augmented QA benchmarks with 3B and 7B backbones. Under the same rollout budget, IGRPO improves over the strongest baseline by 3.1% on average for the 3B model and 0.9% for the 7B model. The larger gain on the smaller model suggests that adaptive allocation is most helpful when the base policy produces more low-value branches. The provided content does not include per-benchmark scores, exact rollout budgets, tree depths, or training-set sizes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–40 minutes. Read the definition of answer-likelihood information gain, the tree rollout policy, the theorem describing the induced teacher distribution, and the main result table for the seven QA benchmarks. For readers focused on reasoning RL, the most relevant part is how the method turns intermediate-state utility into a rollout collection policy. For pretraining-oriented readers, the reusable lesson is that compute allocation during data generation should be tied to information content rather than trajectory count alone.

recommendation.zh: 关注RLHF/RLVR中长序列任务的rollout效率问题，提出的基于信息增益的树搜索策略对优化后训练数据收集有启发，值得一看方法设计。
recommendation.en: Focuses on rollout efficiency in long-horizon tasks for RLHF/RLVR. The proposed information gain-based tree search strategy offers insights for optimizing post-training data collection. The method design is worth a skim.

paper.title: Strategic Bargaining in Multi-Buyer Markets: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards for LLM Negotiations
paper.abstract: Negotiation is a fundamental strategic interaction in management science, characterized by agents attempting to reach agreements while protecting private information, such as reservation costs and hidden valuations. A prevalent yet complex scenario involves a single seller negotiating concurrently with multiple buyers, each possessing heterogeneous, private budgets. In such settings, constrained by a limited number of communication turns, the seller must balance exploring the broader market to d

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在多买家并行谈判中是否能通过可验证奖励训练出有效的探索与议价策略。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在后训练与 agent 决策行为分析：它把 RLVR 放到经济谈判环境里，暴露出语言流畅性和战略探索能力之间的缺口。对基座预训练的直接价值有限，但对“可验证奖励是否足够塑造推理/决策策略”有弱信号。
summary.technical_approach: 构造单卖家、多买家、私有预算、有限轮次的谈判设置，用可验证的谈判收益作为强化学习奖励训练 LLM seller。核心关注探索-利用权衡：模型需要决定是否继续试探其他买家，还是集中轮次推进当前最高出价者。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的主要发现是标准 LLM 虽然语言能力足够，但会过早锁定当前最高出价者，缺少对买家池的系统探索。具体模型规模、训练轮数、baseline 和收益提升幅度在给定信息中未披露。
summary.authors_note: David Simchi-Levi 是 MIT 运筹优化、供应链和管理科学方向的知名研究者；该工作更偏管理科学中的 LLM 决策实验，而不是通用 LLM 训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs can learn effective exploration and bargaining strategies in concurrent multi-buyer negotiations using verifiable rewards.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about post-training and agentic decision behavior. It places RLVR in an economic negotiation setting and exposes a gap between fluent language generation and strategic exploration. The direct value for base pretraining is limited, but it is a useful weak signal on whether verifiable rewards are sufficient to shape decision policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup has one seller, multiple buyers with private heterogeneous budgets, and a limited number of communication turns. The seller policy is trained with verifiable negotiation outcomes as reinforcement learning rewards, with the key tradeoff being whether to explore more buyers or exploit the current best bidder.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that standard LLMs tend to fixate on the current highest bid instead of exploring the buyer pool. Model sizes, training budget, baselines, and quantitative gains are not available from the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: David Simchi-Levi is a well-known MIT researcher in operations research, supply chains, and management science. The work reads more like an LLM decision-making study in management science than a general LLM training paper.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 RLVR 在非数学任务上失效模式的例子；预训练侧不必读正文，看实验设定即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a failure case for RLVR outside math-like tasks; for pretraining work, the setup matters more than the full paper.

paper.title: Decision Protocols in Multi-Agent Large Language Model Conversations
paper.abstract: Improving the task performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential, yet scaling these models faces significant challenges such as diminishing returns and high costs. Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) offer a promising solution by distributing tasks among specialized agents to improve the overall task performance. This can reduce training costs at the expense of increased test time due to the discussion and decision-making process. The decision protocol is a critical component of MAS because it

summary.core_problem: 研究多 LLM agent 对话中的最终决策协议如何影响任务表现，包括投票、共识和 judge 机制。
summary.importance: 贡献是对 multi-agent LLM 决策协议的系统比较，属于 agent test-time compute 与协作机制分析；它不是预训练方法，但对理解多模型推理时的计算分配和聚合策略有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出或整理 MALLM 框架，用统一框架模拟多 agent 对话，并比较 voting、consensus、judge decision 等协议在多类会话任务中的效果。方法重点不是训练新模型，而是改变推理时协作与答案汇聚方式。
summary.experiments: 摘要称覆盖从知识类任务到其他会话任务的多样数据集，并系统评估不同协议；未提供可确认的模型规模、具体 benchmark 名称、提升幅度或统计显著性结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 GippLab, Georg August University of Göttingen。

summary_en.core_problem: The thesis studies how final-decision protocols in multi-agent LLM conversations affect task performance, comparing voting, consensus, and judge-based mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systematic comparison of decision protocols for multi-agent LLMs. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to test-time compute allocation and aggregation behavior in multi-model reasoning systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces or consolidates the MALLM framework to simulate multi-agent discussions under a unified setup, evaluating voting, consensus, and judge decision mechanisms across conversational task solving. The main lever is inference-time collaboration rather than model training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the study evaluates a diverse set of tasks, ranging from knowledge-oriented tasks to other conversational settings, but it does not provide concrete model sizes, benchmark names, effect sizes, or statistical details.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with GippLab, Georg August University of Göttingen.

recommendation.zh: 可看实验表判断 voting/judge 的相对收益；方法本身偏框架比较，不会改变对训练侧的判断。
recommendation.en: Worth checking the result tables for voting-versus-judge behavior; the method is mostly protocol comparison, not a training-side insight.

paper.title: No Time Like the Present: Agentic Test-Time Training for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents often degrade over long episodes: as trajectories grow, they revisit explored states, repeat failed actions, and lose strategies that previously worked. Test-time training (TTT) offers a way to adapt model weights to the evolving task state, but existing LLM TTT methods largely adapt once to a fixed input. We study continuous TTT in multi-turn agent episodes, where each update changes the policy that generates later training text. This creates a self-training loop that helps when new

summary.core_problem: LLM智能体在长轨迹多轮交互中会出现策略漂移：反复重访已探索状态、重复失败动作、遗忘之前有效的策略。现有测试时训练（TTT）方法仅针对固定输入做单次适配，无法处理多轮智能体回合中「更新后的策略反过来生成后续训练数据」的自训练循环带来的漂移放大问题。
summary.importance: 揭示了连续测试时自训练中重复信号会导致策略退化的机制，该规律对理解在线微调、持续学习中的分布漂移也有参考价值；token级重加权的思路可迁移到预训练数据去重、课程学习的样本权重设计中。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Agentic Test-Time Training（aTTT），核心是token级损失重加权机制：在智能体单回合内持续用轨迹数据更新回合专属LoRA适配器时，对出现在历史更新重复n-gram中的token降低损失权重，保留新出现token的完整权重，避免反复在相同的卡住模式上训练导致漂移加剧。同时基于vLLM运行时LoRA API构建并发服务系统，支持同时处理16个智能体回合。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld和SWE-bench Lite两个基准上测试，aTTT效果优于静态预回合适配和无过滤的回合内训练：ALFWorld成功率最高提升5.0个百分点，SWE-bench Lite提升4.9个百分点。增益主要集中在模型本身有解题潜力但长轨迹下容易漂移的场景。并发系统比串行实现快6.6倍，实际耗时仅为无TTT基线的1.9倍。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，重点关注引言部分对「重复自训练循环」失效模式的分析（对应图1、图3），以及aTTT的token重加权公式设计；实验部分注意增益的分布特征——哪些场景有效、哪些场景无收益，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents suffer from policy drift during long-horizon multi-turn interaction: they revisit explored states, repeat failed actions, and lose previously effective strategies as trajectories grow. Existing test-time training (TTT) methods only perform one-time adaptation on fixed inputs, and cannot handle drift amplification caused by the self-training loop in multi-turn agent episodes, where updated policies in turn generate subsequent training data.
summary_en.importance: The work reveals that repeated signals in continuous test-time self-training lead to policy degradation, a mechanism that also informs research on online fine-tuning and distribution drift in continual learning. The token-level reweighting idea can be transferred to pretraining data deduplication and sample weight design in curriculum learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agentic Test-Time Training (aTTT) is proposed with a token-level loss reweighting mechanism. When continuously updating an episode-specific LoRA adapter with trajectory data within a single agent episode, aTTT downweights loss on tokens that appear in repeated n-grams from prior updates, while keeping full weight on novel tokens to avoid amplifying drift from repeatedly training on the same stuck patterns. A concurrent serving system built on vLLM's runtime LoRA API supports 16 simultaneous episodes.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on ALFWorld and SWE-bench Lite, aTTT outperforms both static pre-rollout adaptation and unfiltered in-episode training: it improves ALFWorld success rate by up to 5.0 points, and SWE-bench Lite by up to 4.9 points. Gains concentrate on tasks where the model has inherent solving potential but tends to drift over long trajectories. The concurrent system runs 6.6× faster than sequential implementation, with wall-clock cost only 1.9× the no-TTT baseline.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading.
