We study reward-hacking monitors in ReAct-style agents acting in Gameable ALFWorld and WebShop. Agents are instrumented with activation-based reward-hack scores, token-level entropy, and decision-context features. We find that adapters fine-tuned on \textit{School-of-Reward-Hacks} dataset can transfer reward-hack

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 的安全监控不能简化为对单一内部激活特征阈值化——reward-hack 激活高只是潜在策略状态，是否转化为实际代理利用行为取决于环境上下文（可用动作、parser 约束、proxy reward affordances 等）。
summary.importance: 对 agent 安全监控和机制性可解释性交叉方向有启发。表明部署语义会改变内部安全特征的行为含义——同样的内部状态在不同环境下的风险意义不同。对 RL 训练中 reward hacking 的检测也有间接启示。
summary.technical_approach: 在两个 agent 环境中评估：Gameable ALFWorld（受控修改的 ALFWorld，加入显式 proxy-reward affordances）和 WebShop（购物环境）。使用 ReAct 式 agent + LoRA adapter（在 School-of-Reward-Hacks 数据集或良性数据上微调）。将下一步风险估计建模为 reward-hack 激活、token 级熵、决策上下文（环境状态、推理预算、步骤位置、可用动作）的联合函数，而非单独使用 reward-hack 激活。
summary.experiments: Reward-hack 微调能从文本生成迁移到 agent 动作选择，尤其在环境暴露 proxy-reward affordances 时。Reward-hack 激活在 agent rollout 中保持结构并能区分 adapter 配置，但高激活与下一步风险并非单调关系。加入熵和上下文校准特征改进了风险估计。激活方向 steering 在部分 mixed-adapter regime 中减少了 proxy 利用行为。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 §1 问题框架、环境描述和核心结果图即可。重点理解『内部安全特征需在环境上下文中校准』的核心论点。无需深入技术细节。预计阅读时间 20-25 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Safety monitoring for LLM agents cannot be reduced to thresholding a single internal activation feature. High reward-hack activation only indicates a latent policy state; whether it translates into actual exploitative behavior depends on environment context—available actions, parser constraints, proxy-reward affordances, and other decision-context features.
summary_en.importance: Useful for agent safety monitoring and mechanistic interpretability. Shows that deployment semantics change the behavioral meaning of internal safety features: the same internal state carries different risk significance in different environments. Also indirectly relevant to reward-hacking detection during RL training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Evaluated in two agent environments: Gameable ALFWorld (a controlled modification with explicit proxy-reward affordances) and WebShop (a public shopping environment). Uses ReAct-style agents with LoRA adapters fine-tuned on benign data, reward-hack data (School-of-Reward-Hacks dataset), or mixtures. Formulates next-step risk estimation as a joint function of reward-hack activation, token-level entropy, and decision context (environment state, reasoning budget, step position, available actions), rather than relying on reward-hack activation alone.
summary_en.experiments: Reward-hack fine-tuning transfers from text generation to agentic action selection, especially when the environment exposes proxy-reward affordances. Reward-hack activations remain structured in agent rollouts and separate adapter regimes, but high activation does not monotonically determine next-step risk. Adding entropy and context-calibrated features improves risk estimation. Activation-direction steering reduces proxy-exploit behavior in some mixed-adapter regimes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read §1 framing, environment descriptions, and core result figures. Focus on the central argument that internal safety features must be calibrated against environment context. No need to dig into technical details. Estimated reading time 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将机制分析引入 Agent 的 Reward Hacking 监控，指出单纯看内部激活不够，需要结合上下文和熵，对 RLHF 后的模型行为监控有启发。
recommendation.en: Introduces mechanistic analysis to Agent reward hacking monitoring, pointing out that looking solely at internal activations is insufficient and needs to be combined with context and entropy; inspiring for post-RLHF model behavior monitoring.

paper.title: BAGEN: Are LLM Agents Budget-Aware?
paper.abstract: While agents are increasingly spending more resources, today agent cost is mostly measured only after execution. A Budget-Aware Agent (BAGEN) should treat budget as an active control signal, rather than a passive cost metric. We first systematically define budget estimation as internal budgets (from agent computation) and external budgets (from agent actions). We then formalize budget-awareness as progressive interval estimation: at each step of a plan, an agent should predict an upper and lower

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent研究只把预算（token消耗、API调用费用、时间等）作为事后统计指标，从未系统评估Agent是否能在执行过程中主动估计剩余预算并判断任务可行性。
summary.importance: 首次系统提出并评估Agent的预算感知能力。对于预训练研究的启发在于：这是一种独立于任务表现的元认知能力，现有模型在这方面表现普遍较差；SFT可以唤起潜在的可行性判断能力（25.5%→≈90%），但区间估计需要RL配合，这对后训练阶段能力塑造有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将预算分为两类：内部预算（Agent自身推理的token消耗）和外部预算（行动带来的API费用、金钱、时间等）。提出渐进区间估计（progressive interval estimation）：在Agent每步执行后，要求其给出剩余预算的上下界置信区间，或声明任务不可完成。评估通过rollout-replay协议实现：先无约束记录完整轨迹，再在每步单独查询Agent对剩余预算的估计。分解为三个子能力：可行性预测、早期失败检测、区间校准。
summary.experiments: 在4个环境（Sokoban、Search-R1、SWE-bench、企业级Warehouse）上评测5个前沿模型。关键发现：(1)任务表现与预算感知弱相关（r≈0.35），强表现模型不一定有强预算感知；(2)SFT使Qwen-7B可行性准确率从25.5%提升至≈90%，但区间覆盖率SFT+RL后仅达47%；(3)所有20个模型-环境对都偏乐观，弱模型更乐观；(4)失败轨迹中，模型在60%预算消耗后仍预测可行性>70%，警报只在最后20%时才触发；(5)基于不可行预测的early-stop策略可节省28%-64%token，仅损失1.6-4.2个百分点成功率；(6)RL无SFT暖启动时预算估计训练完全崩溃。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读§3（评估协议定义）、§4-§5（核心实验发现）、§6（训练干预结果）。第2节的单点估计失败分析提供了很好的动机。图5展示的系统性乐观偏差和图6展示的首步/全步估计不一致值得细看。整体为概念性+实验性论文，无复杂数学推导，约45分钟可读完核心内容。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent research has only treated budget (token consumption, API costs, time, etc.) as an ex-post metric, never systematically evaluating whether agents can proactively estimate remaining budget and judge task feasibility mid-execution.
summary_en.importance: First systematic formulation and evaluation of agent budget awareness. For pretraining research, the key insight is that budget awareness is a distinct metacognitive capability separable from task performance. Existing models are universally weak at it; SFT alone unlocks latent feasibility detection (25.5%→≈90%), but interval calibration requires RL—relevant for post-training capability shaping.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes budget into internal (token consumption from agent reasoning) and external (cost of agent actions: API calls, money, time, inventory). Proposes progressive interval estimation: at each execution step, the agent must predict an upper/lower bound on remaining budget, or declare the task impossible. Evaluation uses a rollout-replay protocol: record a full unconstrained trajectory, then separately query the agent at every turn given logged progress. Decomposes into three sub-capabilities: feasibility prediction, early failure detection, and interval calibration.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated five frontier models across four environments (Sokoban, Search-R1, SWE-bench, enterprise Warehouse). Key findings: (1) Task performance and budget awareness are weakly correlated (r≈0.35); strong task models are not necessarily strong budget estimators. (2) SFT raises Qwen-7B feasibility accuracy from 25.5% to ≈90%, but interval coverage reaches only 47% after SFT+RL. (3) All 20 model-environment pairs are optimistically biased; weaker models are more optimistic. (4) On failed trajectories, models still predict >70% feasibility after 60% of budget is consumed; alarms fire only in the final 20%. (5) Early-stop keyed on impossible predictions saves 28%–64% of tokens on failed runs at cost of 1.6–4.2pp success rate. (6) RL without SFT warm-start collapses entirely.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 (evaluation protocol definition), §4–§5 (core empirical findings), and §6 (training interventions). Section 2 provides a concise motivating probe of single-point estimation failures. Figures 5 (systematic optimism bias) and 6 (first-turn vs all-turn disagreement) are particularly informative. Conceptual + experimental paper with no heavy math; core content readable in ~45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 定义了 Agent 的 '预算意识' 并给出了评测方法，发现前沿模型普遍存在过度乐观的资源浪费问题，对 Agent 评测和 RL 奖励设计有启发。
recommendation.en: Defines 'budget-awareness' for Agents and provides an evaluation method, finding that frontier models generally suffer from over-optimistic resource waste. Inspiring for Agent evaluation and RL reward design.

paper.title: Masking Stale Observations Helps Search Agents -- Until It Doesn't: A Regime Map and Its Mechanism

summary.core_problem: 在长轨迹搜索型 agent 中，随着工具调用累积大量 observation，把“过时 observation”从上下文中 mask 掉是一种极简的上下文管理策略；但它到底在什么条件下提升准确率、什么条件下反而伤害性能，以及背后的机制是什么。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“训练动态/数据效率/长上下文使用方式”有间接启发：它把一个看似工程性的 context management 变成可预测的“regime map”（不同模型容量×检索器强度×基线能力下的收益曲线），这类规律常用于反推模型在上下文利用上的瓶颈（检索噪声、注意力分配、错误证据固化）。如果你在做 agentic 数据合成、或用长轨迹工具数据做 continual pretrain/mid-train，这篇的结论能帮助决定：该不该在训练数据里显式加入 observation 丢弃/压缩策略，避免让模型学到依赖陈旧证据的坏习惯。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是系统性 sweep：跨多个 agent backbone（4B 到 284B）、三种 retriever、离线与 live-web 的搜索基准，对比“无管理”与“mask stale observations”的策略。核心产出不是一个新算法，而是经验规律与机制解释：当把“mask 带来的 accuracy gain”对“未做管理时的基线 accuracy”作图时，呈现非对称倒 U：弱 retriever 下几乎是平台期（mask 不怎么帮忙）；强 retriever + 中等容量模型时出现峰值（mask 显著提升）；当模型足够强时出现陡峭崩塌（mask 反而伤害）。论文还试图解释崩塌机制：强模型可能已经能在长上下文中做更精细的证据整合/纠错，粗暴 mask 会删掉对后续推理仍有用的“远期但关键”的证据，或破坏模型形成的内部检索链路。
summary.experiments: 你给的全文片段主要展示了一个 live-web 轨迹案例（搜索引擎把 2003 误导到 2023，agent 在 query reformulation 中振荡），用来说明长轨迹中 observation 会变“陈旧/误导”。摘要声称做了：多模型（4B–284B）、三 retriever、离线+在线基准的系统 sweep，并得到倒 U 形 regime map。但在当前片段里还看不到具体 benchmark 名称、mask 策略的精确定义（如何判定 stale、mask 粒度）、以及关键数值（提升/下降幅度）。如果全文里给了曲线与分段阈值，那部分会是主要可复用资产。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（~20–30 分钟）：
1）先找“mask stale observations”的形式化定义：stale 判定规则、mask 的位置与粒度（token/span/整段 observation）。
2）直接看 regime map 的主图：横轴基线 accuracy、纵轴 gain 的倒 U 形，以及不同 retriever/模型容量的分层。
3）再看机制分析部分：作者如何证明是“证据整合/噪声抑制”而不是别的 confound（例如上下文长度减少带来的纯粹困惑度变化）。
4）最后扫案例与失败模式：强模型崩塌区间到底删掉了什么信息。若你关心 pretrain 数据构造，重点是把这些失败模式转成训练数据的过滤/压缩策略。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon web/search agents, masking stale observations is a minimal context-management intervention. The paper asks when it helps, when it hurts, and what mechanism explains the transition across regimes.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but relevant to training dynamics and data efficiency for agentic trajectories: it turns a heuristic (drop old tool outputs) into a predictable regime map over model capacity and retriever strength. If you generate agentic data for SFT/RL or do continual/mid-training on long tool trajectories, the results inform whether to bake observation dropping/compression into the data pipeline, and when that will backfire by removing long-range evidence the model could have used.
summary_en.technical_approach: They run a systematic sweep across agent backbones (4B–284B) and three retrievers on both offline and live-web search benchmarks, comparing a baseline agent to one that masks stale observations as the trajectory grows. The main empirical pattern is an asymmetric inverted-U when plotting masking-induced accuracy gain against baseline accuracy: (i) a plateau under weak retrievers, (ii) a peak when a strong retriever is paired with a mid-capacity model, and (iii) a sharp collapse for sufficiently strong models where masking becomes harmful. The proposed mechanism is that masking primarily mitigates retrieval noise and reduces distraction for mid-capacity models, but for strong models it deletes still-relevant long-range evidence and disrupts multi-step evidence chains the model can otherwise maintain.
summary_en.experiments: The provided excerpt includes a live-web trajectory illustrating how search bias (2003 vs 2023) can cause oscillatory query reformulations and accumulation of misleading observations. The abstract claims broad sweeps (multiple model sizes, three retrievers, offline + live-web benchmarks) and the regime-map curve, but the excerpt does not expose key experimental specifics: benchmark names, the exact stale-detection rule, masking granularity, or numeric effect sizes. In the full paper, the main reusable artifact should be the regime-map plots and the breakdown by retriever/model size.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 min):
- First locate the formal definition of “stale” and the masking operator (span vs whole observation; how staleness is detected).
- Jump to the main regime-map figure(s): inverted-U curve, stratified by retriever strength and model size.
- Read the mechanism section next: what evidence supports the noise-reduction vs evidence-deletion explanation, and what confounds are controlled.
- Finally scan failure cases in the collapse regime to understand what information gets removed and why strong models suffer. Translate those into data-pipeline rules if you train on long tool trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 别把“丢旧上下文”当万能招：这篇把收益/崩盘的分界条件讲清楚，读 regime map 和机制消融就够，用来校准长轨迹 agent 的上下文策略。
recommendation.en: Don’t treat “drop old context” as a universal fix: the regime map + mechanism ablations are the value—skim those to calibrate context/memory policies for long-horizon agents.

paper.title: Harness Updating Is Not Harness Benefit: Disentangling Evolution Capabilities in Self-Evolving LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed as systems built around editable external harnesses, including prompts, skills, memories and tools, that shape task execution without changing model parameters. Harness self-evolution adapts such agents by updating these harnesses from execution evidence. Yet it remains unclear whether a model's base capability in task-solving predicts its capabilities in harness self-evolution: which models produce useful harness updates, and which actually benefit from them

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要拆开一个过去被端到端指标混在一起的问题：自演化 Agent 的收益，到底来自模型能写出更好的 harness 更新，还是来自任务执行模型能更好地使用这些更新。论文把前者定义为 harness-updating，把后者定义为 harness-benefit，并用固定权重、只更新外部 prompt、skill、memory、tool 等 harness 的设定做系统分析。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不是新的训练 recipe，而是给 Agent 能力评估和后训练目标提供了更清楚的分解。结果显示，基础任务能力并不能很好预测 harness-updating；强模型做 evolver 的边际收益有限。相反，能否调用、理解并持续遵守外部 harness，更像是需要在 Agent 训练或后训练中显式塑造的能力。这个结论对基座模型的 Agent 化训练很有参考价值：不要只扩大反思/更新模型，还要训练模型在长轨迹里检索、激活、遵循外部程序性知识。
summary.technical_approach: 论文形式化了 harness evolution 协议：模型权重固定，Agent 在任务流上执行；执行证据包括失败、反馈、轨迹和成功过程；evolver 根据这些证据写入可持久化的 harness；后续 task-solving agent 在更新后的 harness 条件下执行任务。核心实验设计是交叉配对七个 LLM：固定任务执行 Agent、替换 evolver，用于测 harness-updating；固定 evolver 或使用更新后的 harness、替换任务执行 Agent，用于测 harness-benefit。这个设计比只看最终任务分数更干净，因为它把“谁产生更新”和“谁消费更新”分开。论文进一步分析弱模型收益低的原因，区分出 harness activation failure 和 harness adherence failure：前者是相关 skill 或记忆没有被加载，后者是加载后也无法在长流程中稳定执行。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个 Agentic benchmark 和七个 LLM，包含开源与闭源、不同能力层级模型。主要结果有三点。第一，harness-updating 对基础能力不敏感：固定任务执行 Agent 时，不同 evolver 带来的收益差距在任一 benchmark 上最多约 3.1 个百分点；Qwen3.5-9B 这类较小 evolver 产生的更新，在下游收益上可以接近 Claude Opus 4.6。第二，harness-benefit 呈非单调关系：中等能力模型如 GPT-OSS-120B 从更新 harness 中获益最多；强模型如 Claude Opus 4.6 接近性能上限，提升较小；弱模型虽然理论上有更大提升空间，但实际收益最低。第三，弱模型的问题不是单纯能力天花板，而是 harness 使用失败：例如 Qwen3-32B 的 harness load rate 约 25%，而强模型约 96%；即便加载成功，弱模型在长轨迹中的 adherence decay 也比强模型陡峭四倍以上。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 harness-updating 和 harness-benefit 的问题拆分，以及 Harness-Evolution Capabilities 中的形式化定义。实验部分优先看交叉配对矩阵、固定 Agent 改 evolver 的表格、固定 harness 后替换 task-solving Agent 的图表。最值得细看的是 failure mode analysis：activation failure 和 adherence failure 对 Agent 后训练很有操作意义。若只关心预训练/后训练接口，可以跳过具体 benchmark 细节，保留三条设计建议：能力预算优先给 task-solving agent；harness invocation 需要作为训练目标；长程 instruction following 不能只靠更长上下文窗口解决。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper separates two capabilities that are usually conflated in end-to-end evaluations of self-evolving agents: whether a model can produce useful persistent updates to an external harness, and whether a task-solving model can actually benefit from the updated harness. The harness includes prompts, skills, memories, tools, and other editable non-parametric components around a frozen LLM.
summary_en.importance: The main value is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. It gives a cleaner view of what should be trained in agent-oriented post-training. The results suggest that scaling the model used to write harness updates has limited returns, while the ability to invoke, read, and follow external harness artifacts over long trajectories is a major bottleneck. For foundation model training, this points to explicit objectives around harness invocation and long-horizon instruction adherence, rather than treating external memory or skills as something the model will automatically use.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes a harness-evolution protocol where model weights stay fixed and the external harness is revised from execution evidence. It defines two roles. The evolver produces harness updates from trajectories, failures, feedback, and successful procedures. The task-solving agent consumes the updated harness during later execution. The key experimental design is a cross-pairing setup over seven LLMs and three agentic benchmarks: fix the task-solving agent and vary the evolver to measure harness-updating; vary the task-solving agent under updated harnesses to measure harness-benefit. This isolates update quality from the model’s ability to use the update. The analysis further decomposes weak-model failures into harness activation failure, where the relevant artifact is not loaded, and harness adherence failure, where the artifact is loaded but not followed reliably across a long trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span three agentic benchmarks and seven open- and closed-source LLMs across capability tiers. The main quantitative finding is that harness-updating is nearly flat with respect to base task-solving capability: when the task-solving agent is fixed, changing the evolver changes performance by at most about 3.1 percentage points on any benchmark. A Qwen3.5-9B evolver can produce updates whose downstream gains are close to those from Claude Opus 4.6. Harness-benefit behaves differently. Mid-tier models such as GPT-OSS-120B benefit the most, strong models such as Claude Opus 4.6 often have limited headroom, and weak models benefit the least despite larger apparent headroom. The weak-model gap is tied to harness usage failures: Qwen3-32B has a harness load rate around 25%, compared with roughly 96% for strong models, and its adherence degrades more than four times faster over the trajectory.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the problem decomposition in the introduction first, then the formal definitions of harness-updating and harness-benefit. In the experiment section, focus on the model-pairing tables and the plots that fix the agent versus fix the evolver. The failure-mode analysis is the most useful part for training researchers, especially the distinction between loading a harness artifact and following it over many steps. Benchmark-specific details can be read selectively unless the deployment setting matches the evaluated tasks.

recommendation.zh: 反常识发现值得注意：弱模型更新 harness 的质量并不比强模型差多少——只看核心实验图即可，setup 相对干净。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive finding worth noting: weaker models' harness update quality is surprisingly competitive with stronger models. Scan the core experimental figures only.

paper.title: Meta-Cognitive Memory Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Memory-augmented LLM agents tackle complex long-horizon tasks by recursively summarizing interaction trajectories into compact memory. However, existing approaches typically train these memory policies using outcome-based reinforcement learning, failing to localize where intermediate memory quality degrades. As interactions unfold, ambiguous recursive summaries progressively discard task-relevant information and introduce semantic noise. This exacerbates belief deviation, obscuring the agent's e

summary.core_problem: 记忆增强LLM Agent使用基于最终结果的RL训练记忆策略，存在严重的credit assignment问题：无法定位中间记忆退化位置，不能显式抑制递归摘要中的噪声积累，导致信念偏差（belief deviation）随交互长度加剧。
summary.importance: 对pretrain-posttrain接口有间接启发。核心贡献是提出了一种自监督的中间监督信号（Belief Entropy），通过元认知探针估计模型对任务状态的内在不确定性，替代稀疏的最终结果信号。这一思路与预训练中设计密集自监督信号的理念有共通之处。
summary.technical_approach: 将长程推理建模为POMDP，其中隐藏任务状态需要agent根据信念状态（belief state）行动。递归摘要积累的语义噪声表现为摘要诱导信念的偏差。由于潜在任务状态不可观测，无法直接测量信念不确定性，因此采用元认知探针（受认知科学启发），通过锚定问题（anchor question）估计模型对当前记忆中任务状态的内在不确定性，产生Belief Entropy作为自监督中间信号。基于此提出MMPO（Meta-Cognitive Memory Policy Optimization），在中间记忆状态增加Belief Entropy奖励，补充稀疏的最终结果RL信号。
summary.experiments: 在多个长程Agent基准上进行了实验，证明MMPO有效提升了长程记忆Agent的性能，降低了信念不确定性，提高了长程推理稳定性。（注：全文中实验详细数字未在提供的内容中充分展开）
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Belief Entropy的定义和元认知探针的设计（Section 3），以及POMDP建模框架的推导。预计阅读时间40分钟。核心价值在于中间监督信号的设计思路，而非具体的Agent实验。
summary.authors_note: 未提供作者信息

summary_en.core_problem: Memory-augmented LLM agents trained with outcome-based RL suffer from severe credit assignment: they cannot localize intermediate memory degradation or explicitly suppress noise accumulation during recursive summarization, causing belief deviation to worsen as interactions extend.
summary_en.importance: Indirectly relevant to pretrain-posttrain interface design. The core contribution is a self-supervised intermediate supervision signal (Belief Entropy) that estimates the model's intrinsic uncertainty about task state via a metacognitive probe, offering a dense alternative to sparse final-outcome signals. This aligns with the broader goal of designing dense self-supervised signals in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Long-horizon reasoning is modeled as a POMDP where hidden task states require agents to act on belief states. Semantic noise from recursive summarization manifests as deviation in the summary-induced belief. Since latent task states are unobservable, direct measurement of belief uncertainty is infeasible. The solution adopts a metacognitive probe inspired by cognitive science, using a dedicated anchor question to estimate the model's intrinsic uncertainty about the task state from current memory. This yields Belief Entropy as a self-supervised intermediate signal. MMPO augments outcome-based RL with Belief Entropy rewards at intermediate memory states, providing dense memory-specific supervision beyond sparse final outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments on multiple long-horizon agent benchmarks demonstrate that MMPO improves long-horizon memory agent performance, reduces belief uncertainty, and enhances long-horizon reasoning stability. (Note: detailed experimental numbers were not fully provided in the available content)
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Belief Entropy definition and metacognitive probe design (Section 3), and the POMDP modeling framework. Reading time: ~40 minutes. The core value lies in the intermediate supervision signal design, not the specific agent experiments.
summary_en.authors_note: Author information not provided

recommendation.zh: 阿里提出的用 Belief Entropy 作为 dense reward 来优化 Agent 记忆的方法，思路很 clean，对解决长上下文/长周期任务中的 reward sparsity 问题有启发，值得看其 RL setup 和 reward 设计。
recommendation.en: Alibaba's method of using Belief Entropy as a dense reward to optimize Agent memory is conceptually clean. It offers inspiration for solving reward sparsity in long-context/long-horizon tasks; worth reading for its RL setup and reward design.

paper.title: Agora: Toward Autonomous Bug Detection in Production-Level Consensus Protocols with LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Consensus protocols form the backbone of distributed systems and blockchains, where implementation bugs can cause data corruption and financial losses. While LLM-based approaches show promise in code analysis, they struggle with deep protocol-level logic bugs involving complex state-dependent behaviors across multiple execution stages. We present Agora, a domain-aware multi-agent framework that integrates hypothesis-driven testing with LLM capabilities for systematic protocol verification. Agora

summary.core_problem: LLM 如何在生产级共识协议中检测涉及跨多个执行阶段的复杂状态依赖的协议级逻辑漏洞？
summary.importance: 提出了一个领域感知的多智能体框架 Agora，将假设驱动的测试与 LLM 能力结合，用于系统性的协议验证，超越了单函数代码分析。
summary.technical_approach: Agora 使用专门的 Agent 协作探索协议状态空间，利用特定领域的约束合成攻击场景，并通过迭代细化验证发现；这种显式的角色分离使得能够推理全局协议不变量。
summary.experiments: 在 4 个共识实现（Raft, EPaxos, HotStuff, BullShark）上使用 4 个 SOTA LLMs 评估，发现了 15 个以前未知的协议级逻辑漏洞。

summary_en.core_problem: How can LLMs detect protocol-level logic bugs involving complex state-dependent behaviors across multiple execution stages in production-level consensus protocols?
summary_en.importance: Proposes Agora, a domain-aware multi-agent framework integrating hypothesis-driven testing with LLM capabilities for systematic protocol verification, moving beyond single-function code analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agora employs specialized agents to collaboratively explore protocol state spaces, synthesize attack scenarios using domain-specific constraints, and validate findings through iterative refinement; this explicit role separation enables reasoning about global protocol invariants.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 4 consensus implementations (Raft, EPaxos, HotStuff, BullShark) using 4 SOTA LLMs, discovering 15 previously unknown protocol-level logic bugs.

recommendation.zh: 将 LLM Agent 应用于分布式共识协议的漏洞检测，属于特定领域的复杂 Agent 应用，对通用预训练启发有限，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Applies LLM agents to bug detection in distributed consensus protocols, a domain-specific complex agent application with limited inspiration for general pretraining, keep as literature reference.

paper.title: CausaLab: A Scalable Environment for Interactive Causal Discovery Toward AI Scientists
paper.abstract: We introduce CausaLab, a scalable environment for evaluating interactive causal discovery by LLM agents. Unlike prior evaluations, CausaLab evaluates both whether an agent can solve a problem using causal evidence and whether its answer is grounded in a faithful recovered causal mechanism. Each episode places an agent in a synthetic laboratory: it receives prior measurement records, intervenes on a manipulator crystal, and predicts the resonance frequency of a held-out reactor crystal governed b

summary.core_problem: 现有的因果推理基准测试往往存在“因果鹦鹉（Causal Parrot）”问题，即 LLM 可能仅靠记忆训练数据中的因果事实或语言线索来回答问题，而无法真正像科学家一样通过交互式实验来发现未知的因果机制。
summary.importance: 提出了 CausaLab，一个可扩展的交互式因果发现评估环境。它不仅评估 LLM Agent 的预测准确率，更重要的是评估其预测是否基于忠实还原的底层因果机制（因果图和结构方程），从而真正区分“预测成功”与“因果理解”。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个合成实验室环境，底层由随机采样的结构因果模型（SCM）驱动。Agent 需要通过观察历史记录和对“操作晶体”进行干预实验，来预测另一个遵循相同 SCM 的“反应晶体”的共振频率。CausaLab 引入了一种轻量级领域特定语言（DSL）来记录 Agent 的推理轨迹（假设、计划、行动），从而能够评估机制恢复的保真度，而不仅仅是最终的预测结果。
summary.experiments: 实验揭示了预测准确率和机制恢复保真度之间的巨大鸿沟：Agent 可能在预测上表现良好，但未能恢复正确的因果图或方程。混合的在线观察-干预策略在预测和图恢复之间取得了最佳平衡。此外，模型规模和推理能力（Thinking）的提升在不同图大小和指标上的收益并不均匀，且许多失败源于过早下结论而非预算耗尽。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节关于 CausaLab 环境的设计（特别是 SCM 的随机采样和干预机制），以及第 5 节的实验发现。建议仔细体会“预测成功不等于机制发现”这一核心结论，这对于评估和改进 LLM 的科学发现能力至关重要。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing causal reasoning benchmarks suffer from the 'causal parrot' problem, where LLMs might succeed by memorizing causal facts or linguistic cues from their training data rather than demonstrating the interactive experimental reasoning required to discover unknown causal mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: Introduces CausaLab, a scalable environment for evaluating interactive causal discovery by LLM agents. Crucially, it evaluates not just predictive accuracy, but whether the prediction is grounded in a faithfully recovered underlying causal mechanism (causal graph and structural equations), thus separating 'predictive success' from true 'causal understanding'.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a synthetic laboratory environment driven by randomly sampled Structural Causal Models (SCMs). The agent must predict the resonance frequency of a 'reactor crystal' by observing prior records and performing interventions on a 'manipulator crystal' governed by the same SCM. CausaLab introduces a lightweight Domain-Specific Language (DSL) to track the agent's reasoning trajectory (hypotheses, plans, actions), enabling the evaluation of mechanism recovery fidelity alongside final prediction accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments reveal a persistent gap between predictive accuracy and mechanism recovery fidelity: agents can achieve high accuracy while failing to recover the correct causal graph or equations. A mixed online observation-intervention strategy best balances prediction and graph recovery. Furthermore, the benefits of model scale and 'thinking' capabilities are uneven across graph sizes and metrics, and many failures stem from premature commitment rather than exhausted intervention budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the design of the CausaLab environment (especially the random sampling of SCMs and the intervention mechanism) and Section 5 for the experimental findings. The core conclusion that 'predictive success does not equal mechanism discovery' is critical for anyone evaluating or improving LLMs for scientific discovery.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 LLM '预测准但机制错' 的幻觉现象，对评估模型真正的 reasoning 和 generalization 能力非常有价值，评测设计很严谨。
recommendation.en: Reveals the hallucination phenomenon where LLMs are 'accurate in prediction but wrong in mechanism', highly valuable for evaluating true reasoning and generalization capabilities; rigorous evaluation design.

paper.title: Compute Allocation in Evolutionary Search: From Depth-Breadth to Multi-Armed Bandits
paper.abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search (Evolve systems) has reached state-of-the-art results on mathematical and combinatorial tasks, yet most existing systems report only the best of many runs and leave the run-to-run distribution undocumented. We ask how a fixed budget of LLM calls should be allocated, and how reliably a single run reaches the reported numbers. Sweeping the depth-breadth grid over five models and three tasks, we identify two empirical regularities: a fitness-compute envelope along whi

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM-guided evolutionary search 中固定调用预算该如何在搜索深度与广度之间分配，以及单次运行结果不稳定、只报最好成绩的问题。
summary.importance: 这是对 Evolve 类系统的计算分配规律分析，加上一个 bandit 式预算分配器。对 agent/search 系统设计有方法论价值，但与基座预训练只有间接关系。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先系统扫描 depth-breadth 网格，在 5 个模型、3 个任务上总结两条经验规律：能力与有效 FLOPs 的 envelope，以及带任务交互项的双线性 depth-breadth 拟合；随后提出 BaSE，用多臂老虎机在并行轨迹间动态分配 LLM 调用预算。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个模型和 3 个任务上做 sweep，并在 8 个 model-task 组合上与最强 island-protocol baseline 比较；在不改模型、prompt、evaluator 的前提下，BaSE 的平均 fitness 提升 12.3%。摘要未给出具体模型名称与预算规模。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how to allocate a fixed LLM-call budget between search depth and breadth in LLM-guided evolutionary search, and how unreliable single-run best-case reporting can be.
summary_en.importance: This is a compute-allocation analysis for Evolve-style systems plus a bandit-based scheduler. It is methodologically useful for agent/search systems, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first sweeps the depth-breadth grid over five models and three tasks, identifying two empirical regularities: a capability-vs-effective-FLOPs envelope and a bilinear depth-breadth fit with task-specific interaction. It then proposes BaSE, a multi-armed bandit that allocates LLM calls across parallel trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers five models and three tasks, and compares against a strongest island-protocol baseline over eight model-task cells. Without changing model, prompt, or evaluator, BaSE improves mean fitness by 12.3% on average. The abstract does not specify exact model names or budget sizes.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“报最好一次”换成预算分配与分布分析，这点很干净；只看经验规律和 bandit 调度即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully replaces best-run storytelling with budget allocation and distributional analysis; read the empirical regularities and the bandit scheduler, skip the rest.

paper.title: A Unified Framework for the Evaluation of LLM Agentic Capabilities
paper.abstract: As LLMs are increasingly deployed as agents, reliable assessment of their agentic capabilities has become essential. However, reported benchmark scores often jointly reflect model capability and the implementation choices each benchmark is packaged with, making cross-benchmark results difficult to interpret as clean measurements of the underlying model. In this work, we present a unified framework for the fair evaluation of LLM agentic capabilities. Driven by a unified configuration system, the

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 Agent benchmark 分数不可比的问题：现有评测往往把模型能力、agent scaffold、工具调用格式、parser、环境状态和评测脚本混在一起，导致分数不能干净地反映模型的 agentic capability。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 与 agent 能力评估有实际参考价值。它的核心价值在于把 agent 评测中的混杂因素显式拆开：模型是否真的不会规划，还是不适配某个 benchmark 的输出格式；任务失败来自推理错误，还是来自 live web 环境波动。对于训练侧，这类框架可以帮助判断 SFT/RL 后的 agent 能力提升是否真实，也能为后续构造 agent 数据、工具调用数据和 failure-driven training signal 提供更干净的诊断口径。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不是提出新的 agent 架构，而是统一评测执行协议。作者把 7 个常用 agent benchmarks、24 个领域任务标准化为 instruction–tool–environment triplet，并在固定 ReAct-style scaffold 下运行。这样做的目的不是证明 ReAct 是最优 scaffold，而是固定 scaffold-level 变量，使不同模型和不同任务的结果更可解释。框架包含统一配置系统、工具与环境模块化接口、sandbox replica、可复现的状态改变任务执行，以及面向动态外部资源任务的 offline snapshot 设置。offline 设置尤其关键，因为 live web search 这类任务会把环境时效性、检索失败和模型推理失败混在一起。论文还记录 steps、tokens、runtime 等效率指标，并给出 decision-level 与 execution-level 的失败分类，用于区分规划错误、工具选择错误、格式错误、执行错误等不同失败来源。
summary.experiments: 实验规模较大：15 个模型，超过 400K rollouts，约 5B tokens。主要结果不是单一模型排名，而是展示 benchmark score 的方差来源。第一，original benchmark implementation 与 unified scaffold 下的结果会发生双向变化，说明原始分数中包含 scaffold 和 parser 适配性。脆弱 parser 会压低模型分数，专门设计的 scaffold 也可能抬高分数。第二，online 与 offline 设置对比能拆出环境波动带来的失败，尤其适用于依赖搜索、网页或外部数据库的任务。第三，在统一执行条件下，可以得到更清晰的模型能力画像，包括任务成功率、交互步数、token 成本、运行时间和失败类型分布。论文还展示该框架可迁移到 safety-critical agent evaluation，但从给出的内容看，这部分更像是框架可扩展性的验证。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 confounder 的定义，这决定了论文的价值边界；再看 Unified Framework 中 instruction–tool–environment triplet、固定 ReAct scaffold、sandbox、offline snapshot 的设计。实验部分应优先看 original-vs-unified、online-vs-offline、failure taxonomy 的图表，而不是只看模型 leaderboard。对预训练研究员来说，最值得带走的是评测协议设计思路：如果训练目标是提升 agent 能力，评测必须先把 scaffold 适配、环境波动和模型推理能力分离，否则训练信号和评估结论都会偏。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a measurement problem in agent benchmarks: reported scores often conflate model capability with benchmark-specific scaffolds, tool conventions, parsers, environment states, and evaluation scripts.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for post-training and agent evaluation. Its main contribution is to make the hidden variables in agentic evaluation explicit and controllable. This matters when judging whether SFT or RL actually improves planning and tool use, or merely improves compatibility with a particular scaffold. It also provides a cleaner diagnostic interface for future agent-data generation and failure-driven training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework converts seven widely used agent benchmarks across 24 domains into a standardized instruction–tool–environment format. All tasks are executed through a fixed ReAct-style scaffold under a unified configuration system. The fixed scaffold is not presented as the best agent architecture; it is used to hold major implementation choices constant. The framework also builds sandbox replicas for reproducible state-changing interactions and introduces an optional offline mode for dynamic tasks, using fixed snapshots instead of volatile live resources. In addition to task success, it logs steps, token usage, runtime, and a unified failure taxonomy that separates decision-level and execution-level errors.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers 15 models, more than 400K rollouts, and roughly 5B tokens. The key result is a decomposition of score variance rather than a simple ranking. Re-running original benchmarks under the unified scaffold shifts scores in both directions, showing that parsers and specialized scaffolds can either suppress or inflate performance. Comparing online and offline settings isolates failures caused by live-environment volatility from failures caused by the model. Under controlled execution, the framework yields more interpretable capability profiles, including success rate, interaction length, token cost, runtime, and failure modes. The paper also demonstrates that the same protocol can host safety-critical agent evaluation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Focus on the problem formulation in the introduction, then read the framework design around the instruction–tool–environment abstraction, the fixed ReAct scaffold, sandboxing, and offline snapshots. In the experiments, prioritize the original-versus-unified and online-versus-offline comparisons, plus the failure taxonomy. The useful lesson is methodological: agent capability cannot be evaluated cleanly unless scaffold compatibility and environment volatility are separated from model reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 做LLM预训练Agent能力评测的研究员可参考其标准化框架设计，重点看§2的统一格式定义即可。
recommendation.en: Researchers evaluating LLM pretrain agentic capabilities can refer to its standardized framework design, focus on §2 for unified format definition.

paper.title: When Does Memory Help Multi-Trajectory Inference for Tool-Use LLM Agents?
paper.abstract: Multi-trajectory inference for tool-use LLM agents - generating multiple reasoning attempts and selecting among them - benefits from transferring knowledge across attempts so that later ones avoid the pitfalls of earlier ones. Existing cross-trajectory memory methods (trajectory-level reflection, atomic fact extraction, raw observation injection) are each evaluated under a single inference strategy on a single task, making it unclear whether reported gains reflect properties of the memory abstra

summary.core_problem: 现有工具型LLM Agent的多轨迹推理跨轨迹记忆方法，仅在单一推理策略、单一任务下评估，无法明确性能提升来自记忆抽象本身还是推理方法的特性，且未覆盖无内联验证器的实际部署场景。
summary.importance: 系统拆解了多轨迹记忆的完整设计空间，明确了记忆效果与推理策略、任务属性的匹配规律，为工具型Agent的推理优化提供了可落地的设计参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出统一框架，将多轨迹记忆沿两个正交轴拆解：转移范围（同节点扩展内的兄弟候选间转移、跨完整轨迹转移）和转移内容的抽象层级，派生出4种具体记忆方法；在无内联验证器的部署友好设置下，对4种记忆方法、3种推理策略（best-of-N、波束搜索、MCTS）、4个基准任务做全覆盖组合评估。
summary.experiments: 得到三个核心结论：1）记忆的准确率效果依赖搜索方法，反射式记忆仅在MCTS下有显著提升，兄弟候选内容注入仅能改善波束搜索的多样性不足问题；2）在难度较高的KGQA基准的MCTS设置下，反射式记忆和原始兄弟内容注入的准确率无统计显著差异；3）事实提取式记忆不影响准确率，但在存在可复用环境结构的任务上可提升推理效率。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注框架的双轴设计空间拆解部分和第5章的实验结论。泛读预计耗时12分钟，可跳过具体测试环境的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing cross-trajectory memory methods for multi-trajectory inference of tool-use LLM agents are only evaluated under a single inference strategy and single task, making it impossible to distinguish whether performance gains come from memory abstraction itself or properties of the inference method. They also do not cover practical deployment scenarios without inline verifiers.
summary_en.importance: It systematically decomposes the full design space of multi-trajectory memory, clarifies the matching rules between memory effectiveness, inference strategies and task properties, and provides actionable design references for inference optimization of tool-use agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: A unified framework is proposed that decomposes multi-trajectory memory along two orthogonal axes: transfer scope (transfer between sibling candidates within the same node expansion, cross complete trajectory transfer) and abstraction level of transferred content, from which 4 concrete memory methods are derived. Full combinatorial evaluation is conducted across 4 memory methods, 3 inference strategies (best-of-N, beam search, MCTS), and 4 benchmarks under a deployment-friendly verifier-free setting.
summary_en.experiments: Three core findings are obtained: 1) The accuracy effect of memory depends on the search method: reflection-style memory only brings significant improvements under MCTS, while cross-sibling content injection only alleviates the diversity shortage of beam search; 2) Under MCTS on the harder KGQA benchmark, there is no statistically significant accuracy difference between reflection-style memory and raw sibling injection; 3) Fact-extraction memory does not affect accuracy, but improves efficiency on tasks with reusable environmental structure.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the two-axis design space decomposition of the framework and experimental findings in Section 5. Skim reading takes approximately 12 minutes; implementation details of specific test environments can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: 值得看结果矩阵；关键不是“memory 有用”，而是哪种抽象在无 verifier 搜索里不添乱。
recommendation.en: Read the result matrix; the real question is not whether memory helps, but which abstraction avoids harming verifier-free search.

paper.title: AGORA: Adapter-Grounded Observation-Action Retention for Inference-Free Prompt Compression in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: The token-level extractive compressors widely used for general LM context are structurally inappropriate for LLM agents: across 17 (env, backbone, method) cells spanning two independent token-level method families, every cell collapses to mean reward <= 0.05 despite 1.3-13.3x realized compression. We name and characterize this failure mode as action-grammar destruction -- the tokens carrying action semantics (identifiers, brackets, action verbs) are exactly those self-information ranks lowest, s

summary.core_problem: 通用token级抽取式压缩器在LLM Agent场景存在结构性失效：携带动作语义的token（标识符、括号、动作动词等）因自信息低被优先删除，导致压缩后的轨迹不符合Agent动作语法要求，环境直接拒绝执行，性能坍缩到接近零。
summary.importance: 明确了Agent场景与通用LLM场景prompt压缩的结构性差异，发现了动作语法破坏这一新的失效模式，为Agent轨迹压缩的设计空间提供了明确的约束条件。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AGORA，无额外LLM推理开销的step级压缩框架，包含三个核心组件：1）结构解析器：将Agent轨迹按角色标记分段为系统块、任务块、历史动作-观测对、当前观测等类型化块；2）强制保留层：无条件保留格式关键的系统、任务、当前观测，以及最近2步的历史轨迹，保证基础格式正确性；3）轻量级相关性打分器：125M参数的RoBERTa，基于“删除某步是否会改变下一步动作”的反事实标签训练，对剩余历史步骤打分，按预算贪心保留得分最高的步骤；所有保留的步骤均完整保留原文，从构造上保证动作语法不被破坏。
summary.experiments: 在17组（环境、骨干模型、压缩方法）的测试中，现有token级压缩器（Selective Context、LLMLingua-2及其微调版本）均导致平均奖励≤0.05，出现结构性失效；AGORA在9个测试场景中的8个保留了≥75%的未压缩基线性能，压缩比可达1.0-11.5倍；每步压缩仅需约2ms，无额外LLM调用开销。消融实验显示强制保留层是性能的主要贡献来源，学习到的打分器负责在固定保留率下实现自适应端到端压缩。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2章关于token级压缩器失效机制的分析，理解动作语法破坏的核心逻辑；查看第4章的失效模式验证实验和AGORA的性能对比结果，第5章的消融实验有助于理解各组件的贡献，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: General token-level extractive compressors suffer from structural failure in LLM Agent scenarios: tokens carrying action semantics (identifiers, brackets, action verbs, etc.) are preferentially removed due to low self-information, resulting in compressed trajectories that do not meet the action grammar requirements of agents, leading the environment to directly reject execution and performance collapsing to near zero.
summary_en.importance: This work clarifies the structural difference between prompt compression for Agent scenarios and general LLM scenarios, identifies action-grammar destruction as a new failure mode, and provides clear constraints for the design space of Agent trajectory compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: AGORA, an inference-free step-level compression framework, is proposed with three core components: 1) Structural parser: segments Agent trajectories into typed blocks (system block, task block, historical action-observation pairs, current observation) according to role markers; 2) Always-keep floor: unconditionally retains format-critical system content, task content, current observation, and the 2 most recent historical steps to guarantee basic format correctness; 3) Lightweight relevance scorer: a 125M-parameter RoBERTa trained on counterfactual labels (whether deleting a step would change the next action), which scores remaining historical steps and greedily retains the highest-scoring steps within the budget. All retained steps are kept verbatim, ensuring action grammar is preserved by construction.
summary_en.experiments: Across 17 test cells (environment, backbone model, compression method), existing token-level compressors (Selective Context, LLMLingua-2 and its fine-tuned variant) all cause mean reward ≤ 0.05, showing structural failure. AGORA retains ≥ 75% of the uncompressed baseline performance in 8 out of 9 test scenarios, with compression ratios ranging from 1.0× to 11.5×. Each compression step takes only ~2ms with no additional LLM call overhead. Ablation experiments show that the always-keep floor is the main contributor to performance, while the learned scorer enables adaptive end-to-end compression under a fixed keep ratio.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of the failure mechanism of token-level compressors in Chapter 2 to understand the core logic of action-grammar destruction. Check the failure mode verification experiments and AGORA performance comparison results in Chapter 4. The ablation experiments in Chapter 5 help understand the contribution of each component. Estimated reading time is 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 action-grammar destruction 的诊断即可；这是 prompt compression 迁移到 agent 时最容易踩的坑。
recommendation.en: Read the action-grammar destruction diagnosis; it captures the main trap when porting prompt compression to agents.

paper.title: Adapting the Interface, Not the Model: Runtime Harness Adaptation for Deterministic LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents are shaped not only by their language models, but also by the runtime harness that mediates observation, tool use, action execution, feedback interpretation, and trajectory control. While existing agent adaptation methods mainly update model parameters, many failures in deterministic, rule-governed domains stem from mismatches at the model--environment interface. We propose Life-Harness, a lifecycle-aware runtime harness that improves frozen LLM agents without changing model weights o

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“如何把 agent 模型再训好一点”，而是一个更靠近系统接口的问题：在确定性、规则约束很强的环境里，很多失败并不来自模型缺少推理能力，而来自模型与环境之间的运行时接口不匹配。具体表现包括：观察组织方式不利于决策、工具契约描述不清、模型输出的动作在语义上对但在执行层面不可落地、环境反馈没有被转成恢复信号、轨迹进入重复或停滞后缺少调节机制。论文要解决的是，能否只利用训练轨迹，把这些反复出现的接口级失败沉淀成稳定的 runtime harness 干预项，在不改模型参数、不改评测环境的前提下，提升冻结 agent 在未见任务上的表现。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接贡献训练 recipe 的论文；但它对 pretrain/post-train 接口有现实意义。第一，它把 agent 能力拆成“模型能力”和“接口暴露能力”两部分，提醒人们不要把所有交互失败都归因到 base model 不够强。第二，它给出一个较干净的证据：同一套 harness 只用 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 的训练轨迹演化出来，却能迁移到另外 17 个模型骨干上，说明其中确实捕捉到了环境侧的稳定结构，而不是某个模型特有的行为习惯。第三，它提示一个重要方向：在很多 deterministic agent 场景里，继续往模型权重里塞 domain-specific 行为，未必比把环境契约、动作规范化、恢复策略显式放到运行时层更划算。对做预训练的人，这意味着后训练收益的一部分可能来自接口工程，而不是纯粹来自更强的 next-token 建模。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个 lifecycle-aware 的运行时 harness，名字叫 Life-Harness。它不是在线搜索任意 harness 代码，也不是在评测时持续自我修改，而是先在训练任务轨迹上做失败诊断，再把高频失败归纳成可复用的、分层的接口干预，最后在 held-out evaluation 时固定下来使用。

论文把 agent 交互过程拆成四层。
1）Environment Contract Layer：在交互前校准工具描述、参数约束、接口规则和环境契约，目标是减少模型把通用 tool-use 先验误用到特定环境上的情况。它更像是把“这个环境到底允许你怎么做”讲清楚，而不是让模型自己从失败中慢慢猜。
2）Procedural Skill Layer：从训练轨迹里抽取可复用的程序性技能或操作套路，在当前任务和状态下检索使用。这里的重点不是把技能蒸馏进模型，而是把它们保留为外部可审计的过程知识。
3）Action Realization Layer：对模型生成的动作做校验、规范化和必要的纠错。若错误属于无歧义的接口级错误，就在执行前修正；若动作确定会失败，则直接阻断。这个设计针对的是“意图对了，但格式、参数、调用方式错了”的常见 agent 失败。
4）Trajectory Regulation Layer：在执行后监控轨迹动态，检测重复、停滞、无效重试、预算耗尽等退化模式，并触发恢复机制。它相当于给 agent 加了一层 episode-level 控制，而不是只看单步动作。

这套方法和已有 scaffold/harness 优化工作的区别在于：它把 harness 看成稳定的运行时接口，而不是一个任意可搜索的策略程序；它强调 failure localization，把失败定位到交互生命周期中的具体层级；它要求训练期演化、评测期冻结，避免把 held-out evaluation 变成在线适配。这个设定让结果更容易解释：提升来自接口结构化，而不是评测时继续学习。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 7 个确定性 agent 环境，来自 τ-bench、τ²-bench 和 AgentBench，任务类型包括家庭交互、网页购物、操作系统控制、数据库任务和带政策约束的业务流程。模型方面一共评测了 18 个 backbone，包含 instruction-tuned、reasoning-oriented 和 agent-specialized 模型。

最关键的结果有三点。
第一，Life-Harness 在 126 个 model-environment 组合中的 116 个上带来提升，平均相对提升为 88.5%。这个数字是相对提升，不是绝对百分点，但覆盖面很广，说明它不是只对某一类模型或某一类环境有效。
第二，harness 只用 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 的训练轨迹演化，却能直接复用到其余 17 个模型上。这是论文最有说服力的实验之一，因为它支持作者的核心论点：学到的是环境侧结构，而不是模型私有补丁。
第三，方法与模型训练是互补的。论文给出的例子是，加入 Life-Harness 后，基础模型 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 可以超过其 tool-specialized 衍生模型 xLAM-2-32b-fc-r；而在 xLAM 本身上继续加 harness 还能进一步提升。这说明接口层改进并不只是替代模型训练，也可以叠加在已有 agent-specialized 模型之上。

引言里还给了一个动机性对比：Qwen3.5-4B 在 HMMT 数学基准上有 74.0%，但在 ALFWorld 上只有 43.1%。作者用这个例子说明，静态能力和交互能力之间存在明显落差，后者常常受接口问题主导。若看全文，真正值得注意的不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是作者围绕失败类型做的分层分析：哪些收益来自工具契约澄清，哪些来自动作规范化，哪些来自轨迹调节。若正文附有分层消融，这部分应重点看，因为它决定了方法到底是在“修格式”还是在“补策略”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐段细抠。建议先看 Introduction，把作者的问题设定吃透：他们不是在做 agent policy learning，而是在做 model-environment interface adaptation。然后重点看方法总览图和四层设计，确认每一层分别处理什么失败、为什么要分层而不是做一个统一的黑盒 harness。实验部分优先看三类结果：一是跨 18 个模型的迁移性；二是不同环境上的覆盖面；三是与 agent-specialized 模型的互补性。

如果时间有限，30 分钟左右可以抓住主线。若想判断它对自己是否有启发，重点看两处：一是 harness 的演化过程是否依赖大量人工规则，还是能较自动地从轨迹中归纳；二是 action realization 和 trajectory regulation 的边界在哪里，是否只是工程性 guardrail，还是形成了可复用的 agent runtime abstraction。对做预训练的人，最值得深挖的是作者如何证明“收益来自接口而非隐式泄漏任务答案”，以及这种接口层方法能否反过来指导 post-train 数据构造。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a system-interface problem rather than a model-training problem. In deterministic, rule-governed agent environments, many failures do not come from missing reasoning ability in the base model. They come from mismatches at the model-environment boundary: poorly structured observations, unclear tool contracts, actions that are semantically plausible but not executable, feedback that is not converted into recovery signals, and trajectories that fall into repetition or stagnation. The central question is whether one can mine training trajectories for recurring interface failures, convert them into reusable runtime interventions, and improve frozen agents on held-out tasks without changing model weights or evaluation environments.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-agent stack. It separates agent performance into model capability and interface exposure, which is useful when interpreting failures of strong base models in interactive settings. The strongest evidence is transfer: the harness is evolved only from Qwen3-4B-Instruct trajectories, yet it improves 17 other backbones as well. That suggests the method captures stable environment-side structure rather than model-specific behavior. For foundation-model researchers, the practical implication is clear: in many deterministic domains, pushing more domain behavior into weights may be less efficient than making contracts, action canonicalization, and recovery policies explicit in the runtime layer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is a lifecycle-aware runtime harness called Life-Harness. It does not fine-tune the model, and it does not perform unconstrained online code search during evaluation. Instead, it analyzes training trajectories, localizes recurring failures, converts them into structured interventions, and then freezes the resulting harness for held-out evaluation.

The design has four layers.
1) Environment Contract Layer: calibrates tool descriptions, interface constraints, and environment-specific contracts before interaction. The goal is to reduce the mismatch between generic tool-use priors in the model and the actual rules of the environment.
2) Procedural Skill Layer: distills reusable procedures from training trajectories and retrieves them conditioned on the current task and state. The key choice is to keep these procedures external and auditable rather than absorb them into model parameters.
3) Action Realization Layer: validates, canonicalizes, and, when unambiguous, repairs model-generated actions before execution. It also blocks actions that would deterministically fail. This directly targets a common agent failure mode: the intent is roughly correct, but the action is malformed at the interface level.
4) Trajectory Regulation Layer: monitors post-execution dynamics and detects degeneracy patterns such as repetition, stagnation, invalid retries, or budget exhaustion, then triggers recovery behavior.

What distinguishes this from prior scaffold or harness optimization work is the framing. The harness is treated as a stable runtime interface, not as an arbitrary policy program to be searched. Failures are localized to stages of the interaction lifecycle. Evolution happens on training trajectories, while evaluation remains fixed. That makes the gains easier to interpret: they come from structured interface adaptation rather than hidden online learning.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers 7 deterministic agent environments from τ-bench, τ²-bench, and AgentBench, spanning household interaction, web shopping, operating-system control, database manipulation, and policy-constrained business workflows. The paper tests 18 model backbones, including instruction-tuned, reasoning-oriented, and agent-specialized models.

Three results matter most.
First, Life-Harness improves 116 out of 126 model-environment pairs, with an average relative improvement of 88.5%. This is a relative gain, not an absolute point increase, but the breadth of improvement is the main signal.
Second, the harness is evolved only from Qwen3-4B-Instruct trajectories and then reused across the other 17 backbones. This is the most convincing part of the paper because it supports the claim that the method captures reusable environment structure rather than model-specific patches.
Third, the method is complementary to model training. The paper reports that Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct with Life-Harness can outperform its tool-specialized derivative xLAM-2-32b-fc-r, while adding the harness to xLAM itself still yields further gains. That argues for interface adaptation as an additive layer, not merely a substitute for agent fine-tuning.

The introduction also gives a motivating gap: Qwen3.5-4B scores 74.0% on HMMT but only 43.1% on ALFWorld. The point is not the specific numbers; it is the mismatch between static capability and interactive performance. When reading the full paper, the most useful experimental detail is the layer-wise analysis of where gains come from: contract clarification, action canonicalization, or trajectory regulation. That determines whether the method is mostly fixing formatting errors or providing a more substantive runtime control abstraction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and the main method figure to lock in the framing: this is interface adaptation, not policy learning. Then read the four-layer design carefully and ask what failure mode each layer addresses, and why the authors chose a layered runtime abstraction instead of a single learned scaffold. In the experiments, prioritize three things: transfer across 18 backbones, coverage across environments, and complementarity with agent-specialized models.

A 30-minute read is enough to get the main idea. If you want to judge whether it has deeper value, focus on two questions. First, how much of the harness evolution is automated from trajectories versus hand-authored rules. Second, where exactly the boundary lies between action realization and trajectory regulation, and whether the result is a reusable runtime abstraction or mostly a collection of guardrails. For foundation-model work, the most interesting follow-up question is whether these interface failures can be turned into better post-training data or supervision signals.

recommendation.zh: 不微调模型仅优化运行时harness的思路很有启发性，重点看§3的四类干预策略设计。
recommendation.en: Optimizing runtime harness instead of fine-tuning models is highly insightful; focus on §3 four intervention strategy designs.

paper.title: AstraFlow: Dataflow-Oriented Reinforcement Learning for Agentic LLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to improve the reasoning, coding, and tool-use capabilities of large language models, but agentic RL remains prohibitively expensive. Scaling RL to agentic LLMs requires supporting complex workloads, including multi-policy collaborative training, while efficiently using elastic, heterogeneous, and cross-region compute resources. Existing LLM RL systems support some of these capabilities, but each new extension often requires dedicated system engin

summary.core_problem: 现有面向LLM的RL训练系统采用以训练器为中心的控制架构，缺乏标准化组件抽象，适配多策略协同训练、异构/弹性跨区域算力等智能体场景时需要大量定制化开发，成本极高。
summary.importance: 为LLM智能体的规模化RL训练提供了通用基础设施设计参考，降低RL预训练、多智能体协同训练的工程落地成本。
summary.technical_approach: 采用数据流导向的架构设计，核心包含三个组件：1）数据流层：通过共享数据而非中心化训练器控制协调推理采样、训练、数据处理组件，支持多策略训练、课程调度、数据过滤采样等逻辑以数据流策略实现；2）采样即服务（RaaS）：将轨迹生成与策略优化解耦，支持异构/弹性算力下采样组件独立扩缩容；3）训练器：仅负责从数据流层消费数据、回传更新权重，可独立替换，无需改动其他系统模块。
summary.experiments: 在多策略协同RL场景下，训练速度比现有多智能体RL系统最高提升2.7倍，精度相当；原生支持采样自动扩缩容、异构跨区域训练，无需定制代码；可直接集成动态采样、GRESO、缓存回放等数据算法。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节的架构设计部分和第4节的多策略训练、系统灵活性实验，预计阅读时间15-20分钟，不需要深入实现细节，关注架构抽象思路即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL training systems for LLMs adopt trainer-centric control architectures and lack standardized component abstractions, requiring heavy custom engineering to support agentic scenarios such as multi-policy collaborative training, heterogeneous/elastic cross-region compute, leading to prohibitive costs.
summary_en.importance: Provides a general infrastructure design reference for large-scale RL training of LLM agents, reducing engineering overhead for RL pretraining and multi-agent collaborative training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts a dataflow-oriented architecture with three core components: 1) Dataflow layer: Coordinates rollout, training, and data processing components via shared data instead of centralized trainer control, supporting multi-policy training, curriculum scheduling, data filtering/sampling as native dataflow policies; 2) Rollout-as-a-Service (RaaS): Decouples trajectory generation from policy optimization, enabling independent scaling of rollout components across heterogeneous/elastic compute resources; 3) Trainers: Only consume data from the dataflow layer and publish updated weights, can be replaced independently without modifying other system modules.
summary_en.experiments: In multi-policy collaborative RL scenarios, it achieves up to 2.7x training speedup with comparable accuracy to existing multi-agent RL systems; natively supports rollout auto-scaling, heterogeneous cross-region training without custom code; can directly integrate data algorithms including dynamic sampling, GRESO, buffer replay.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (architecture design) and Section 4 (multi-policy training, system flexibility experiments). Estimated reading time is 15-20 minutes. No need to dive into implementation details, just grasp the architecture abstraction ideas.

recommendation.zh: 读系统抽象和调度实验即可；做 RLVR 时，rollout、dataflow、trainer 解耦是该复现的工程 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the system abstraction and scheduling results; for RLVR, decoupling rollout, dataflow, and trainers is the engineering prior to reproduce.
