paper.title: BenchGuard: Who Guards the Benchmarks? Automated Auditing of LLM Agent Benchmarks
paper.abstract: As benchmarks grow in complexity, many apparent agent failures are not failures of the agent at all - they are failures of the benchmark itself: broken specifications, implicit assumptions, and rigid evaluation scripts that penalize valid alternative approaches. We propose employing frontier LLMs as systematic auditors of evaluation infrastructure, and realize this vision through BenchGuard, the first automated auditing framework for task-oriented, execution-based agent benchmarks. BenchGuard cr

summary.core_problem: 解决复杂执行型 LLM agent benchmark 中，任务失败究竟来自模型能力不足还是 benchmark 规范、脚本与评测基础设施本身缺陷的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 审计工作，不直接改进预训练，但对 agent 评测可信度有现实价值。贡献主要是提出自动化审计框架，并实证说明现有知名 benchmark 中确实存在会误判模型能力的致命缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BenchGuard，用前沿 LLM 作为系统化审计器，对 benchmark 的任务说明、输入输出约束、执行脚本和评测逻辑做结构化交叉核验；可选地引入 agent 解答或执行轨迹作为额外诊断证据，以定位不可解任务、隐含假设、过于僵硬的评分脚本等问题。
summary.experiments: 在两个科学类 agent benchmark 上验证：在 ScienceAgentBench 中发现 12 个被作者确认的问题，其中包括使任务不可解的致命错误；在 BIXBench Verified-50 子集上，与专家识别问题的匹配率达到 83.3%，并发现部分人工审查遗漏的问题。摘要未给出更完整的模型配置与审计成本细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Washington Allen School、Phylo、Genentech。不是顶级实验室的基座研究论文，更像评测基础设施质量控制方向。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a basic but important question in execution-based LLM agent benchmarks: when an agent fails, is it a model failure or a benchmark infrastructure failure?
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark-auditing paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it matters for evaluation reliability. The main contribution is an automated auditing framework showing that prominent agent benchmarks contain defects severe enough to mis-measure model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: BenchGuard uses frontier LLMs as structured auditors to cross-check benchmark artifacts, including task specs, assumptions, execution scripts, and evaluation logic. It can optionally incorporate agent solutions or execution traces as extra evidence to diagnose unsolvable tasks, hidden assumptions, and overly rigid graders.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on two scientific agent benchmarks: it found 12 author-confirmed issues in ScienceAgentBench, including fatal errors that make tasks unsolvable, and matched 83.3% of expert-identified issues on the BIXBench Verified-50 subset while catching issues missed by human review. The abstract does not provide full model/cost details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Washington Allen School, Phylo, and Genentech. This is better read as evaluation-infrastructure work than as frontier foundation-model research.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座方法论文，但如果你常拿 agent benchmark 做结论，这篇会提醒你先审 benchmark 再审模型；正文只看错误类型和人工一致性结果即可。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper, but if you use agent benchmarks to make capability claims, this is a useful reminder to audit the benchmark before blaming the model; the error taxonomy and human-agreement results are enough.

paper.title: Automated Adversarial Collaboration for Advancing Theory Building in the Cognitive Sciences
paper.abstract: Cognitive science often evaluates theories through narrow paradigms and local model comparisons, limiting the integration of evidence across tasks and realizations. We introduce an automated adversarial collaboration framework for adjudicating among competing theories even when the candidate models and experiments must be discovered during the adjudication process. The system combines LLM-based theory agents, program synthesis, and information-theoretic experimental design in a closed loop. In a

summary.core_problem: 用 LLM agent、程序合成和实验设计构成闭环，自动比较认知科学中的竞争理论。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是科学发现 Agent 的概念验证。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，也不是通用 Agent benchmark，但提出了一个较完整的闭环：理论生成、模型实现、实验选择、证据更新。对通用 research agent 设计有少量参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 系统由 LLM-based theory agents 提出或维护候选理论，用 program synthesis 生成可执行模型，再用 information-theoretic experimental design 选择能区分理论的实验。整个过程循环执行，目标是在候选模型和实验都需要动态发现的情况下完成 adversarial collaboration。
summary.experiments: 论文在模拟研究中覆盖三个经典 categorization theories，并在不同噪声设置下测试。系统能在多数设置中恢复 ground-truth theory，但在最困难噪声条件下可靠性下降。摘要未给出 LLM 型号、程序合成细节、实验轮数或成功率表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Princeton University Department of Psychology、Stanford University Department of Psychology 和 Princeton AI Lab。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a closed-loop system using LLM agents, program synthesis, and experimental design to adjudicate competing theories in cognitive science.
summary_en.importance: This is a proof of concept for scientific-discovery agents. It is not an LLM pretraining paper or a general agent benchmark, but the loop of theory proposal, executable modeling, experiment selection, and evidence update is relevant to research-agent design.
summary_en.technical_approach: LLM-based theory agents maintain candidate theories, program synthesis turns them into executable models, and information-theoretic experimental design selects experiments that best discriminate among theories. The loop is meant to support adversarial collaboration when both candidate models and experiments must be discovered during the process.
summary_en.experiments: A simulation study spans three classic categorization theories under multiple noise settings. The framework recovers the ground-truth theory in most settings, with weaker reliability in the hardest cases. The abstract does not report LLM model names, program-synthesis details, number of experimental rounds, or success-rate tables.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Princeton University Department of Psychology, Stanford University Department of Psychology, and Princeton AI Lab.

recommendation.zh: 方法像科学发现 Agent 雏形，但实验是小型仿真；只看闭环设计，不读认知科学细节。
recommendation.en: It sketches a scientific-discovery agent, but the evidence is a small simulation; read the closed-loop design and skip the cognitive-science details.

paper.title: Exploration and Exploitation Errors Are Measurable for Language Model Agents

summary.core_problem: 在无法访问LM agent内部策略/价值函数的情况下，仅从外显动作轨迹中，如何可操作地区分并量化“探索不足/探索冗余”与“利用不足/利用冗余”的错误，并构造可控环境系统性地调节探索/利用难度以评测不同agent的失败模式。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线（数据/Tokenizer/Scaling/训练动态）关联较弱，更偏agent评测与行为度量。但对RL pretrain/持续学习方向有启发：作者尝试用“策略无关（policy-agnostic）”的结构性冗余度量来诊断行为错误，避免把评测绑定到某个最优策略或语义先验；同时通过去语义化（DAG节点用符号表示）减少模型利用预训练知识投机取巧。这类评测设计可用于检验RL式训练是否真正改善探索/利用，而不是提升语义猜测能力。
summary.technical_approach:
框架由两部分：
1）可控任务环境：部分可观测2D grid map + 未知任务DAG。agent通过移动逐步揭示局部地图与任务节点位置；任务由DAG先决条件约束，最终达成唯一goal节点。关键设计是把DAG语义信息替换为符号表示，迫使agent依赖环境交互而非预训练语义。
2）策略无关错误度量：不定义最优策略，而是在“无进展片段”中基于图论的冗余/重复概念检测“任何合理策略都不应产生”的结构性冗余动作，并根据当时地图状态把错误归因到探索、利用或两者。并通过程序化生成地图拓扑与DAG复杂度来分别增强探索难度（更宽、更稀疏节点等）或利用难度（更密依赖、更浅路径等）。
summary.experiments: 作者在多种地图配置下评测多个前沿LM agent，报告不同模型呈现不同探索/利用失败模式；并做prompt类型与显式agent harness的消融，结论是“少量harness工程即可同时改善探索与利用”。但在当前提供的正文片段中未出现具体模型名单、分数、误差率等数字，无法可靠复述定量结果。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30-40分钟）：
- 先读Task Formulation把环境状态定义（observed/unobserved/unknown）与DAG节点状态（undiscovered/discovered/achieved）搞清楚。
- 重点看错误度量的正式定义（正文后半与Appendix B/相关附录），理解“无进展片段”如何切分、冗余如何判定、以及探索/利用归因规则。
- 实验部分主要看：不同地图生成参数如何对应探索/利用难度；harness/prompt消融带来的变化是否一致、是否存在过拟合评测指标的风险。

summary_en.core_problem: How to disentangle and quantify exploration vs. exploitation failures of LM agents using only observed action trajectories (no access to internal policies/values), and how to build controllable environments that can systematically dial exploration difficulty and exploitation difficulty to reveal distinct failure modes.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining/scaling/tokenizer paper; it is primarily an agent evaluation + metric design contribution. The relevance to RL-pretrain / continual learning is methodological: (i) a policy-agnostic behavioral error metric that does not assume an optimal policy, and (ii) a de-semanticized task construction (symbolic DAG nodes) that reduces leakage from pretrained world knowledge. Such setups can be useful to test whether RL-style training genuinely improves exploration/exploitation rather than exploiting semantic priors.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two key components:
1) Environment: partially observable 2D grid navigation coupled with an unknown task DAG. Moving reveals local map structure and whether a cell contains a task node; DAG prerequisites constrain which nodes can be achieved before the goal. Node semantics are replaced with symbols to prevent semantic shortcutting.
2) Policy-agnostic error metric: instead of measuring deviation from an optimal policy, the metric flags structurally redundant actions within trajectory segments where the agent makes no progress toward task completion, inspired by graph-theoretic redundancy/reuse notions. Each flagged error is attributed to exploration, exploitation, or both based on the map/task state. Map topology and DAG complexity are programmatically varied to emphasize exploration vs. exploitation demands.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates multiple frontier LM agents across diverse generated maps, reporting distinct exploration/exploitation failure modes. It also ablates prompt styles and explicit agent harness components, concluding that minimal harness engineering can improve both exploration and exploitation. The provided excerpt does not include concrete model lists or quantitative scores, so exact numbers cannot be cited here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–40 minutes):
- Read Task Formulation to internalize the state definitions (observed/unobserved/unknown cells; undiscovered/discovered/achieved DAG nodes).
- Focus on the formal definition of the error metric (main text + Appendix B): how “no-progress segments” are detected, what constitutes redundancy, and how attribution to exploration vs. exploitation is decided.
- In experiments, prioritize the map/DAG generation knobs and the harness/prompt ablations; assess whether improvements reflect real capability gains or metric-specific gaming.

recommendation.zh: 读它的度量定义即可：用 policy-agnostic 的结构冗余把探索/利用错误从轨迹里拆出来，适合拿来做 RL-pretrain 前后诊断而非追分。
recommendation.en: Read for the metrics: policy-agnostic structural redundancy teases apart exploration vs exploitation errors from trajectories, useful as a before/after diagnostic for RL-pretraining rather than leaderboard chasing.

paper.title: Agent^2 RL-Bench: Can LLM Agents Engineer Agentic RL Post-Training?

summary.core_problem: 论文要回答的问题是：LLM 智能体能否在受限工程预算内，端到端“工程化”完成 agentic RL post-training（从目标理解、方案选择、代码实现/调参/排错、到在线采样闭环训练与多次提交），并真实提升给定基座模型的可测评性能；以及现有偏静态的后训练/自动化基准为何会高估这种能力。
summary.importance: RL 后训练已成为对齐与专精的关键路径，但真正落地需要跨奖励设计、算法选择、稳定性、数据/轨迹管线、在线交互与诊断迭代等系统工程能力。若智能体能自动化该流程，将显著降低模型研发门槛；反之，若基准只测“写出训练脚本/做 SFT”，就无法评估智能体是否具备构建可运行在线 RL 系统的能力，因此需要覆盖训练结构的交互式评测与可诊断的行为记录。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Agent^2 RL-Bench：以“训练结构覆盖（training structure coverage）”为核心设计原则，构造 6 个任务、3 个难度层级的基准来逐级增加结构性要求。每个实例由任务描述D、基座模型M0、训练数据T、评测oracle O、时间预算τ定义；智能体A在预算内可迭代实现训练、提交候选模型并以“预算内最佳提交”的提升幅度作为得分（相对M0的 improvement）。
Level 1：静态、规则可验证任务（如 GSM8K、HumanEval），主要考察数据构造与监督训练闭环；
Level 2：静态但基于 judge 的非确定性奖励（如 AlpacaEval），要求对噪声/非确定信号进行优化；
Level 3：强交互任务（ALFWorld、WebShop、DeepSearchQA），必须实现环境交互、轨迹采集、基于轨迹级奖励的闭环在线 RL，并在固定 12 小时预算内迭代。
此外，基准强调“行为诊断”：为每次运行提供隔离工作区与 grading API；运行时 instrumentation 记录每次提交、代码修订、模型产物；并用事后分析模块自动生成结构化 case study 与 run report，用于分析智能体如何搜索、失败与自适应，而不仅是最终分数。
summary.experiments:
作者在受控实验中评估 5 套 agent 系统（跨 3 类 scaffold）与 6 个 driver LLM（如 OpenHands、OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI）。主要发现：
1）在部分交互任务上可获得巨大增益：例如 ALFWorld 上，一个“RL-only”智能体通过 SFT warm-up + GRPO + 在线 rollouts，将分数从 5.97 提升到 93.28，显示智能体在特定环境中能搭建有效闭环。
2）但在其他交互任务上进展有限：如 DeepSearchQA 仅 +2.75，接近评测噪声，暴露在线 RL 工程稳定性与有效性难以复现。
3）在固定 scaffold 内更换 driver 会显著改变结果：在 Qwen3-8B-Base 的受控研究中，ALFWorld 的提升可从接近 0 变为 +78 个百分点，提示“driver 选择/能力”对交互式后训练成败影响很大。
4）总体上，在固定预算下，监督式管线往往主导最终最优路线；在线 RL 作为最终最佳路径只在 ALFWorld 上稳定胜出，说明“会写 RL 代码”与“能跑通 RL 系统并稳定提升”之间存在系统性鸿沟。
summary.reading_guide:
skim（泛读建议：方法概述+看点）：
- 重点读 Introduction：理解为何静态基准会高估能力、以及 Level 1→3 的结构递进逻辑。
- 读“Benchmark formulation/score=improvement + best-within-budget”相关段落：把握评测协议与迭代提交机制。
- 快看实验结论段：ALFWorld 的大幅提升 vs DeepSearchQA 的边际提升，以及“driver 影响巨大”的结论。

must_read（精读建议：详细技术分析+看点）：
- 精读基准定义部分：实例五元组(D,M0,T,O,τ)、迭代提交与 run-level best score 的设计动机（贴近真实后训练工作流）。
- 精读 Level 1/2/3 的“结构性要求”差异：
  1) Level 1 的确定性验证如何让 SFT 足以拿高分；
  2) Level 2 的 judge 噪声如何改变优化问题（非确定奖励下的策略选择与稳定性）；
  3) Level 3 对 rollout/trajectory reward/online collection 的硬约束如何逼出系统工程能力。
- 精读“runtime instrumentation + post-hoc analysis”设计：它如何把一次 run 的代码/模型/提交序列转化为可复盘的行为证据（对诊断 agent 策略尤关键）。
- 精读受控 scaffold–driver 实验：理解作者如何隔离变量、以及为何得出“driver 决定交互任务成败”的证据链。
- 创新点抓手：训练结构覆盖的任务选择原则；best-within-budget 的迭代评测协议；全程工件记录与自动化 run report（让 benchmark 不止是 leaderboard，而是行为科学仪器）。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：仅靠静态/半静态后训练基准无法评估“工程化在线 RL”的真实能力；必须引入需要环境交互与轨迹闭环的任务，并配套可观测、可复盘的行为记录与分析。实验上他们既展示了智能体在个别环境可实现惊人提升，也强调这种成功并不稳健、强依赖完整 agent stack（尤其 driver），从而揭示当前智能体距离可靠自动化 RL 系统工程仍有明显差距。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM agents can autonomously engineer end-to-end agentic RL post-training under a limited engineering budget—i.e., understand objectives, choose methods, implement/debug full pipelines (including online rollouts and trajectory-level rewards), iteratively submit models, and measurably improve a given foundation model—while diagnosing why existing mostly-static benchmarks can overestimate this capability.
summary_en.importance: RL post-training increasingly drives alignment and specialization, but real-world deployment requires expert system engineering across reward design, algorithm choice, stability, data/trajectory pipelines, and online interaction. If agents could automate this loop, they would become powerful model-development tools. However, benchmarks that can be solved largely by SFT do not test interactive RL engineering; thus, an evaluation must cover training-structure requirements and provide behavioral observability beyond final scores.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Agent^2 RL-Bench is introduced with a “training structure coverage” principle: 6 tasks across 3 levels, each level adding a structural requirement not present before. Each instance is defined by (task description D, base model M0, training data T, evaluation oracle O, time budget τ). Within τ, an agent A can iteratively implement training, run experiments, and submit candidate models via a grading API; the run score is the best improvement over M0 achieved within budget (best-within-budget), mirroring real post-training iteration.
Level 1: static rule-based tasks with deterministic verification (e.g., GSM8K, HumanEval) to test data construction + supervised training.
Level 2: static but judge-based, non-deterministic rewards (e.g., AlpacaEval), requiring optimization under noisy signals.
Level 3: fully interactive environments (ALFWorld, WebShop, DeepSearchQA) requiring environment interaction, trajectory collection, and closed-loop online RL within a fixed 12-hour budget.
For diagnosis, the benchmark provides isolated workspaces, runtime instrumentation that logs every submission/code revision/model artifact, and a post-hoc analysis module that auto-generates structured case studies and run reports—enabling analysis of how agents search, fail, and adapt.
summary_en.experiments:
Across controlled experiments with five agent systems (three scaffold families) and six driver LLMs (e.g., OpenHands, OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI), results show:
1) Large interactive gains can occur on some tasks: on ALFWorld, an RL-only agent improves from 5.97 to 93.28 using SFT warm-up + GRPO with online rollouts.
2) Progress can be marginal on others: DeepSearchQA improves only +2.75, within evaluation noise, indicating difficulty in reliably engineering stable online RL.
3) Driver choice can dominate outcomes: in a controlled study on Qwen3-8B-Base, switching drivers within the same scaffold changes ALFWorld improvement from near-zero to +78pp.
4) Under fixed budgets, supervised pipelines often dominate; online RL emerges as the final best route reliably only on ALFWorld—highlighting a gap between writing RL code and running effective RL systems.
summary_en.reading_guide:
skim (high-level + what to read):
- Read the Introduction for the motivation: why static benchmarks overstate post-training competence and why Level 1→3 is diagnostic.
- Read the benchmark protocol: improvement-over-base and best-within-budget iterative submissions.
- Skim the main experimental findings: ALFWorld’s dramatic gains vs DeepSearchQA’s marginal gains, plus the “driver matters a lot” takeaway.

must_read (deep technical + what to focus on):
- Study the formal instance definition (D, M0, T, O, τ) and the best-within-budget scoring rationale.
- Carefully compare Level 1/2/3 structural requirements:
  (i) deterministic verification where SFT can suffice,
  (ii) judge-noise optimization in Level 2,
  (iii) mandatory rollout/trajectory-reward/online collection in Level 3.
- Deep-read the instrumentation + post-hoc analysis design: how full run artifacts become behavioral evidence.
- Deep-read the controlled scaffold–driver experiment to understand the causal claim that driver choice strongly affects interactive RL engineering.
- Key innovations to track: training-structure coverage as benchmark design; iterative best-within-budget evaluation; full run logging + automated run reports for behavioral diagnosis.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that static or semi-static post-training benchmarks are insufficient to evaluate true online RL engineering competence. Meaningful evaluation requires interactive environments plus instrumentation for behavioral diagnosis. Their experiments intentionally show both extremes—spectacular success on ALFWorld and near-failure elsewhere—and emphasize that success depends on the full agent stack (especially the driver), revealing a persistent gap between generating RL code and reliably operating RL systems end-to-end.

paper.title: Escaping the Context Bottleneck: Active Context Curation for LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 在长时序任务中受“上下文瓶颈（Context Bottleneck）”与“Lost-in-the-Middle”影响：环境观测极度冗长高熵（网页 DOM、检索结果噪声），把原始信息不断堆进上下文会迅速降低信噪比，导致推理链条级联失败。现有被动记忆/检索式方法把上下文管理当静态检索问题，容易出现 retrieval bias，尤其难以召回与当前 query 文本不相似但因果关键的“reasoning anchors”。
summary.importance: 长链路 agent 的核心不是“更大上下文窗口”，而是“更高信噪比的工作记忆”。如果不能在交互过程中主动压缩噪声、保留关键锚点，前沿模型的推理能力会被环境熵淹没，导致成功率下降与 token 成本飙升。论文提出把“上下文管理”从工程技巧提升为可学习的策略能力，并通过小模型 + RL 训练实现可扩展的部署形态（不需要对闭源大模型做 on-policy 微调）。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 ActiveContext：将系统解耦为两部分的“共生架构”。
- TaskExecutor：强大的冻结基础模型（可为闭源 SOTA），负责推理与执行。
- ContextCurator：轻量策略模型（文中示例 7B），负责主动整理工作记忆。
核心将上下文管理建模为序贯决策：在 POMDP 视角下，ContextCurator 与环境交互，目标是进行“主动信息熵降低（active information entropy reduction）”——激进剪枝结构/语义噪声，同时保留稀疏但对未来推理至关重要的 reasoning anchors。
训练方式为 on-policy 强化学习：用 TaskExecutor 的任务成功作为远期（distal）奖励信号，驱动 ContextCurator 学会在每步选择保留/丢弃/压缩哪些观测与历史，从而把 TaskExecutor 的注意力集中在高信号内容上。该设计绕开了“把记忆管理塞进同一个大模型里导致容量分裂/成本过高”的问题。
summary.experiments:
在 WebArena 与 DeepSearch 上验证：
- WebArena：Gemini-3.0-flash 成功率 36.4% → 41.2%，同时 token 消耗降低 8.8%（47.4K → 43.3K）。
- DeepSearch：成功率 53.9% → 57.1%，token 近 8× 降低（46.7K → 6.6K）。
- 额外结论：7B 的 ContextCurator 在上下文管理能力上可匹配 GPT-4o，说明“上下文整理”是一种可被小模型高效学习并外包的独立技能，从而在成本与效果上形成新的 Pareto 前沿。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：详细技术分析 + 重点章节/图表/创新点）
- 精读 Introduction：抓住作者对“问题不在 context 长度而在 SNR”的论证，以及对被动检索记忆 retrieval bias 的批评（reasoning anchors 概念是全文主线）。
- 精读 Methodology：重点看 POMDP 建模与“ContextCurator 的动作空间/状态表示/对 TaskExecutor 的接口”如何设计（上下文是如何被剪枝与保留的）。同时关注 RL 信号如何从 TaskExecutor 的成功率回传到 curator（distal reward 的 credit assignment 直觉）。
- 重点看实验表（Tables 1/2）：成功率提升与 token 降低的同时发生是关键卖点；建议对比 baseline（无 curator）并思考是否存在任务分布偏置。
- 关注“7B 匹配 GPT-4o”结论对应的设置：评估指标到底衡量的是“管理质量”还是“端到端成功率”，以及 TaskExecutor 是否固定。
- 创新点提炼：①解耦架构（小模型管记忆，大模型管推理）；②把上下文管理显式做成 RL 策略学习；③以熵降低/锚点保留为目标而非相似度检索。

skim（泛读建议：方法概述 + 推荐看哪些部分）
- 读 Introduction 前半：理解 Context Bottleneck 与 Lost-in-the-Middle 的动机。
- 快读框架描述：ContextCurator/TaskExecutor 两模块 + RL 训练的远期奖励。
- 直接看 WebArena/DeepSearch 的主结果数字（成功率与 token）。
- 若只选一段细看：reasoning anchors 的定义与例子（解释为何检索式记忆会漏）。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调“上下文管理是一种独立的认知技能”，可以通过 RL 在小模型上学习，并与冻结的强推理大模型形成共生分工：小模型负责把高熵环境压缩成高信噪比工作记忆，大模型负责在更干净的上下文上做推理与行动，从而同时提升成功率并显著降低 token 成本。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents fail on long-horizon tasks due to the Context Bottleneck and Lost-in-the-Middle: high-entropy observations (web DOM noise, verbose search results) accumulate, degrading signal-to-noise ratio and causing cascading reasoning failures. Existing passive memory/retrieval systems treat context management as static retrieval, suffering retrieval bias and often missing causally crucial but textually dissimilar “reasoning anchors.”
summary_en.importance: For long-horizon agents, the limiting factor is not merely context window size but effective working-memory SNR. Without actively pruning noise and preserving key anchors, even frontier models degrade while token costs explode. The paper elevates context management into a learnable policy skill that can be offloaded to a small model, enabling scalable deployment without on-policy tuning of expensive/closed-source foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ActiveContext is a symbiotic, decoupled architecture:
- TaskExecutor: a powerful frozen foundation model (possibly closed-source) for reasoning and task execution.
- ContextCurator: a lightweight policy model (e.g., 7B) that actively curates the working memory.
Context management is framed as sequential decision-making under a POMDP. Trained with on-policy RL using a distal reward based on TaskExecutor success, the ContextCurator learns active information entropy reduction: aggressively prune structural/semantic noise while preserving sparse reasoning anchors critical for future deductions. This avoids the “capacity split” of monolithic approaches and the brittleness/bias of similarity-based retrieval.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported gains on WebArena and DeepSearch:
- WebArena: Gemini-3.0-flash success 36.4% → 41.2%, with 8.8% fewer tokens (47.4K → 43.3K).
- DeepSearch: success 53.9% → 57.1%, with ~8× token reduction (46.7K → 6.6K).
- Additional claim: a 7B ContextCurator matches GPT-4o in context-management performance, suggesting context curation is a distinct skill that small models can learn efficiently, improving the Pareto frontier of success vs cost.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep technical + how to read)
- Introduction: focus on the argument that SNR—not raw context length—is the core bottleneck, and on the definition/role of “reasoning anchors.”
- Methodology: examine the POMDP formulation and, concretely, how the curator interfaces with the executor (what is kept/pruned/compressed) and how distal rewards enable learning despite credit assignment challenges.
- Main result tables (Tables 1/2): the key claim is simultaneous success gains and token reductions; compare against the no-curator baseline.
- Scrutinize the “7B matches GPT-4o” setup: what metric is used (end-to-end success vs curation quality), and what is held fixed.
- Innovations to extract: (i) decoupled curator/executor roles, (ii) RL-trained active curation, (iii) entropy reduction + anchor preservation rather than similarity retrieval.

skim (high-level + what to read)
- Read the first half of the Introduction for motivation (Context Bottleneck, Lost-in-the-Middle).
- Skim the architecture description (ContextCurator + TaskExecutor, RL with distal reward).
- Jump to WebArena/DeepSearch headline numbers (success and tokens).
- If reading one concept section: the definition and examples of reasoning anchors (why retrieval fails).
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ thesis is that context management is an independent cognitive capability: a small RL-trained curator can transform high-entropy environments into high-SNR working memory for a frozen strong executor, improving success while sharply reducing token usage—without needing to fine-tune proprietary frontier models.

recommendation.zh: 看 RL 学到的上下文裁剪策略与对照：它改变我对“更大窗口就行”的 prior，动作是把 context curation 作为可训练小模型组件而非静态检索。
recommendation.en: Focus on the learned context-pruning policy and controls: it updates the “just buy a bigger window” prior; actionable move is to treat context curation as a trainable small-model module, not static retrieval.

paper.title: $λ_A$: A Typed Lambda Calculus for LLM Agent Composition

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM agent 框架（LangChain/DSPy/CrewAI/AutoGen 等）的配置（多为 YAML/JSON）缺乏形式语义：无法原则性判断配置是否“结构完备/良构”、是否会终止、不同配置是否语义等价、以及重构是否保持语义不变。结果是开发者只能靠试错，且容易出现如 ReAct 循环缺少终止分支导致无限循环/被动截断、router 路由分支不全导致运行时错误等问题。
summary.importance:
论文把“agent 配置语言”提升为可证明性质的形式系统：给出可执行的操作语义与类型系统，并从语义直接推导静态 lint 规则。意义在于：
1) 让 agent 组合具备可验证的安全性/终止性边界（至少对 bounded ReAct）；
2) 为跨框架的 agent 架构提供统一中间表示（typed calculus fragment）；
3) 把工程痛点（配置缺陷、语义纠缠、重构不可控）转化为可自动检测与可解释的语义错误。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 λ_A：在 simply-typed lambda calculus 上扩展出面向 agent 组合的 11 个构造子，并给出小步/大步语义与类型系统。
关键原语（5 个不可由其他构造表达）：
- lam：oracle abstraction（LLM 调用），以模型参数 θ 与 prompt p 作为调用上下文；
- tool：外部函数调用（工具）；
- fix_n：有界不动点（bounded recursion），用于刻画 ReAct 循环；
- mem：可变环境/持久化 store σ（带容量与 TTL 元数据），并引入 store typing Σ；
- ⊕_p：概率选择。
其余 6 个为可派生但保留为一等构造（便于可读性、针对性 lint、独立优化）：函数组合 >>、并行 |（pair）、if/case/route（多分支）、pair 与投影、guard（失败则 stuck 到 ⊥）。
形式化结果：
- 类型安全（type safety）：良类型项不会出现“未定义行为”，运行要么产生对应类型值，要么触发受控的 stuck/guard failure；
- fix_n 终止性：有界不动点在 n 步界内保证归约终止（可能归约到 ⊥ 表示截断/卡住，而非无限归约）；
- lint 规则健全性：从操作语义推导结构性错误模式（如缺少终止分支、maxSteps=0、路由不穷尽），并证明规则对语义错误的 soundness；
- 部分 Coq 机械化：约 1567 行、43 个证明完成。
工程实现：Python DSL “lambdagent”，包含 from_config 编译器（把 YAML/框架配置编译到 λ_A 项）与 lint 工具；并提出“语义纠缠”现象：大量框架把关键控制流/终止逻辑放在 Python 代码而非 YAML。
summary.experiments:
数据与评测：
- 收集 17 个仓库、6 个框架的 835 份真实 GitHub agent 配置；
- 在 λ_A 语义下，94.1% 配置被判定为“结构不完备”（structurally incomplete），即存在可由语义刻画的结构性缺陷或缺失关键分支/终止条件；
- 通过 fault injection 做 lint 规则正确性验证：42 个测试，precision/recall 均为 100%；
- 仅基于 YAML 的 lint 精度估计约 54%（人工核验）；结合 YAML + Python AST 联合分析后精度提升到 96–100%（在 50 与 175 样本上验证）；并发现约 46% 的生产配置存在“语义纠缠”（语义分散在 YAML 与 Python 代码中）；
- 架构统一性展示：五类主流 agent 范式（LangGraph 图状态机、CrewAI 角色驱动、AutoGen 多智能体、OpenAI/Claude SDK wrapper、Dify 低代码）均可嵌入为 λ_A 的带类型片段（命题 7.2），并在 835 配置与 125 个语义忠实度测试上验证。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读：详细技术分析 + 建议）
- §3–§4：核心。逐条理解 11 个构造子、store σ/Σ 的定义、以及小步/大步语义如何刻画 oracle/tool/mem/fix_n/route。
- §5：证明主线。重点看：Type Safety（定理 5.3）的进展/保持（progress/preservation）结构；fix_n 终止性（定理 5.4）如何用“步数界”保证归约结束；lint soundness（定理 5.8）如何把“配置缺陷”形式化为可证明的语义性质。
- Lint 规则示例（文中提到的 L003/L004/L013）：把每条规则对应到具体语义失败模式（fix_0→⊥、case 无 base 分支导致 fix_n 截断、route 非穷尽导致 RouteError）。建议对照一个真实配置的编译结果（from_config 输出的 λ_A 项）逐步手算/跟踪归约。
- §6：实现对齐。关注 DSL 如何“忠实实现”语义，以及 from_config 的编译假设（论文也承认缺少独立 YAML 形式语义，因此 adequacy 主要靠实证）。
- §7：实证与“语义纠缠”。重点看：为何 YAML-only 会低精度、联合 Python AST 如何定位终止逻辑/控制流；以及跨框架嵌入（命题 7.2）如何作为统一 IR。
skim（泛读：方法概述 + 建议）
- 读 Introduction + Overview：抓住动机（配置无语义→无法判定良构/终止）与三个代表性错误（缺 terminate、maxSteps=0、route 不全）。
- 快速扫 §3 的语法与“5 个原语 + 6 个派生但保留”的设计理由。
- 直接看 §7 的关键数字：94.1% 不完备、46% 语义纠缠、联合分析精度 96–100%，以及五类范式统一嵌入的结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者核心立场是：现实中的 agent 配置“已经在隐式编码一个 lambda calculus”，把它显式化能立刻带来可证明的性质与可落地的工具（lint/编译/跨框架统一）。同时作者对“编译充分性（YAML→语义）”保持谨慎：由于缺少独立的配置语言形式语义，选择用大规模真实配置与语义忠实度测试来支撑 adequacy，而把可证明部分集中在 λ_A 本身与由其导出的 lint 规则上。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agent frameworks typically define agents via YAML/JSON, but these configurations lack formal semantics: there is no principled way to decide whether a configuration is well-formed/structurally complete, whether it terminates, whether two configs are semantically equivalent, or whether refactoring preserves meaning. This leads to trial-and-error engineering and recurring failures such as ReAct loops without a termination branch, maxSteps=0 producing immediate failure, or non-exhaustive routers causing runtime RouteError.
summary_en.importance: The paper turns agent configuration into a formally analyzable and partially mechanized system: a typed calculus with operational semantics and provable properties, plus lint rules derived from the semantics rather than heuristics. It matters because it (1) provides verifiable safety and bounded-termination guarantees for common agent control patterns, (2) offers a unifying intermediate representation across frameworks, and (3) makes configuration bugs statically detectable and explainable in semantic terms.
summary_en.technical_approach:
It introduces λ_A, extending the simply-typed lambda calculus with 11 term formers and both small-step and big-step semantics, plus a type system.
Five primitive (non-derivable) constructs capture agent-specific effects:
- lam: oracle abstraction (LLM call) parameterized by model params θ and prompt p;
- tool: external function/tool invocation;
- fix_n: bounded fixpoint for ReAct-style loops;
- mem: mutable environment / persistent store σ with capacity and TTL metadata, together with store typing Σ;
- ⊕_p: probabilistic choice.
Six additional constructs are derivable but kept first-class for readability, targeted linting, and optimization: composition (>>), parallel pairing (|), if/case/route, pairs and projections, and guard (failing to stuck term ⊥).
Formal results include:
- Type safety: well-typed terms do not exhibit undefined behavior; execution yields a value of the declared type or a controlled stuck/guard failure.
- Termination of bounded fixpoints: fix_n always reduces within the step bound (possibly to ⊥, representing truncation rather than divergence).
- Soundness of derived lint rules: structural configuration errors (missing base case/termination, zero-step loops, non-exhaustive routes) are proven sound w.r.t. the operational semantics.
- Partial Coq mechanization: ~1,567 LOC with 43 completed proofs.
Implementation: a Python DSL (lambdagent) that realizes λ_A, a from_config compiler, and a semantics-driven lint tool; the work highlights “semantic entanglement,” where key control-flow/termination logic lives in Python rather than YAML.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluation highlights:
- Dataset: 835 real-world GitHub agent configurations from 17 repos and 6 frameworks.
- Under λ_A semantics, 94.1% are structurally incomplete.
- Lint correctness via fault injection: 42 tests with 100% precision/recall.
- YAML-only lint precision is estimated at ~54% (manual verification); combining YAML with Python AST analysis raises precision to 96–100% (validated on 50 and 175 samples).
- 46% of production configurations exhibit semantic entanglement (semantics split across YAML and Python).
- Architectural unification: five mainstream paradigms (LangGraph state machines, CrewAI role-driven, AutoGen multi-agent, OpenAI/Claude SDK wrappers, Dify low-code) embed as typed fragments of λ_A (Prop. 7.2), validated on 835 configs and 125 semantic-faithfulness tests.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep technical reading)
- §3–§4: Core calculus. Understand each of the 11 constructs, the store model (σ/Σ), and how the operational semantics models oracle/tool/mem/fix_n/route.
- §5: Proof backbone. Focus on type safety (Thm 5.3: progress/preservation structure), bounded-fixpoint termination (Thm 5.4: step-index/bound argument), and lint-rule soundness (Thm 5.8: mapping config defects to semantic failure modes).
- Track concrete lint rules (e.g., L003/L004/L013) back to semantic phenomena (fix_0→⊥, missing base case causing fix_n truncation, non-exhaustive route causing RouteError). Re-derive one example by compiling a real config to a λ_A term and stepping through reductions.
- §6: Implementation fidelity. Inspect how the DSL/compiler preserves the intended semantics; note the paper’s stance that compilation adequacy is argued empirically due to the lack of an independent formal YAML semantics.
- §7: Empirics + semantic entanglement. Pay attention to why YAML-only analysis fails, how joint YAML+Python AST recovers missing semantics, and how Prop. 7.2 supports cross-framework unification.
skim (high-level reading)
- Read Introduction + Overview for motivation and the three canonical failure cases (missing terminate, maxSteps=0, non-exhaustive router).
- Skim §3 syntax and the “5 primitive + 6 derived-but-first-class” design rationale.
- Jump to §7 for the headline numbers (94.1% incomplete, 46% entanglement, 96–100% precision with joint analysis) and the cross-paradigm embedding claim.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ thesis is that real-world agent configurations already encode a lambda-calculus-like structure; making it explicit yields immediate, provable benefits (safety/termination bounds) and practical tooling (semantics-derived linting and compilation). They are careful about compiler adequacy: since there is no independent formal semantics for YAML configs, they support adequacy empirically (large-scale configs + faithfulness tests) while keeping the formally proven claims centered on λ_A itself and the lint rules derived from its operational semantics.

recommendation.zh: 别把它当 agent 论文看：它给“配置=程序”一个可判定的良构/终止边界；只读类型规则+静态 lint 推导，够你回去改内部 DSL。
recommendation.en: Treat it as “configs are programs”: the value is a checkable notion of well-formedness/termination; skim the typing rules + how they derive lints, then steal the ideas for your internal agent DSL.

paper.title: From Agent Loops to Structured Graphs:A Scheduler-Theoretic Framework for LLM Agent Execution

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦于当前最常见的 LLM Agent 执行范式“Agent Loop”（单模型在不断增长的上下文中迭代决定下一步）所带来的结构性缺陷：步骤依赖隐式不可验证、失败恢复缺乏有界语义导致可能无限重试、执行计划在上下文中被静默改写从而难以审计与调试。
summary.importance: 这些问题会在任务复杂度上升时系统性放大：隐式控制流使得正确性与可复现性难以保证；无界恢复使得成本与时延不可控；计划可变导致事后无法追责与定位错误。作者还通过对 70 个开源项目的调查指出 Agent Loop 占比高（约 60%），说明该问题具有广泛工程现实性。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个“调度器理论（scheduler-theoretic）”框架，将 Agent Loop 重新刻画为一种 single-ready-unit scheduler：任一时刻最多只有一个可执行单元处于 ready 状态，且调度决策由不透明的 LLM 推理给出。由此把 Agent Loop 与图执行引擎放在同一语义连续体上，用两个关键维度比较：ready-set 基数（可同时调度的就绪单元数量）与策略显式性（调度策略是否可检查/可确定）。在此基础上提出 Structured Graph Harness（SGH/Graph Harness）：将控制结构从上下文“抬升”为显式静态 DAG，并做三项强约束承诺：(1) 计划版本在其生命周期内不可变（immutable commitment）；(2) 规划、执行、恢复三层解耦并定义清晰接口；(3) 恢复遵循严格升级协议（escalation）以避免无界 replanning。SGH 支持建设性并行（constructive parallelism），但为可控性明确排除竞争性并行（competitive parallelism）、递归子图扩展、父链回滚等更强表达能力。论文还给出节点状态机与在公平性假设下的终止性/健全性保证，并提出分组消融协议（G_plan、G_scaffold、G_graph、G_patch、G_replan 等）以隔离各设计决策贡献。
summary.experiments: 从给定全文片段可确认：作者设计了“七组实验协议”用于分离不同结构化设计带来的增益，并在引言中明确其目标是对比 Agent Loop、图执行与中间形态，验证沿 ready-set/策略显式性梯度的可测收益假设；同时论文包含对 70 个开源系统的实证调查（方法与细节在附录 A.5）。但当前提供内容未包含具体任务基准、指标数值与完整结果表，因此无法在不臆测的前提下复述定量结论。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】建议按“问题→框架→方案→保证→实验协议”快速抓主线：1) Introduction：三大结构性缺陷 + single-ready-unit scheduler 关键洞见；2) 框架定义：执行系统 tuple (S,U,P,O,Δ) 与 ready-set/策略显式性两轴；3) SGH 三层分离与不可变计划版本；4) 并行性分类（constructive vs competitive）及为何排除后者；5) 实验分组命名（G_plan/G_scaffold/...）理解作者如何做因果归因。
【must_read（精读）】重点精读形式化与可验证性部分：1) SGH 的执行语义：DAG、节点状态机、计划版本化与接口边界（规划/执行/恢复）；2) 终止性与健全性证明所依赖的公平性假设与其工程含义（哪些调度/重试策略会破坏假设）；3) 恢复升级协议如何“有界化”重试与 replanning（对比 Agent Loop 的无界行为）；4) 设计取舍章节：为何排除 competitive parallelism、递归扩展、回滚（理解可控性/表达性/可实现性的三角权衡）；5) 实验协议：七组对照如何隔离每个设计承诺的贡献（读表/读图时关注每组只改一个变量的严谨性）。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：Agent Loop 的问题不是“提示词不够好”或“模型不够大”，而是控制流与恢复语义缺乏结构化承诺；因此需要把执行从“上下文里的隐式计划”迁移到“可检查、可版本化、可证明终止”的显式图结构，并用调度器视角统一比较不同 agent 执行范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets structural weaknesses of the dominant LLM-agent execution paradigm, the Agent Loop (a single model iteratively decides the next step from an ever-growing context): (i) step dependencies are implicit and unverifiable, (ii) failure recovery has unbounded semantics and may retry indefinitely, and (iii) the execution plan can be silently rewritten in-context, making auditing and debugging difficult.
summary_en.importance: These issues become systemic as tasks grow: implicit control flow undermines correctness and reproducibility; unbounded recovery makes cost/latency unpredictable; mutable plans prevent faithful post-hoc traceability. A survey of 70 open-source agent projects (≈60% using Agent Loops) suggests the problem is widespread in real systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a scheduler-theoretic lens: an Agent Loop is characterized as a single-ready-unit scheduler—at any time, at most one executable unit is ready, and the dispatch decision is produced by an opaque LLM inference rather than an inspectable policy. This places Agent Loops and graph executors on a single semantic continuum parameterized by (a) ready-set cardinality and (b) policy explicitness. Building on this, they propose Structured Graph Harness (SGH/Graph Harness): lift control from implicit context into an explicit static DAG with three commitments: (1) immutable plan versions during their lifetime, (2) strict separation of planning, execution, and recovery layers with well-defined interfaces, and (3) a recovery escalation protocol that prevents unbounded replanning. SGH supports constructive parallelism (all branches must complete) but deliberately excludes competitive parallelism (race-and-cancel), recursive subgraph expansion, and parent-chain rollback for controllability. The paper also specifies a node state machine and provides termination/soundness guarantees under explicit fairness assumptions, plus a seven-group ablation protocol (G_plan, G_scaffold, G_graph, G_patch, G_replan, etc.) to isolate each design decision’s contribution.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-content excerpt: the paper includes (i) a survey of 70 open-source systems (details in Appendix A.5) and (ii) a seven-group experimental protocol intended to attribute gains to individual structural choices and to test hypotheses along the ready-set/policy-explicitness gradient. However, the excerpt does not include the concrete benchmark setup, metrics, or numerical results, so no quantitative claims are reproduced here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【Skim】Follow the main narrative: (1) Introduction for the three structural failures and the single-ready-unit scheduler insight; (2) the formal tuple (S,U,P,O,Δ) and the two comparison axes (ready-set size, policy explicitness); (3) SGH’s immutable plan versioning and three-layer separation; (4) constructive vs competitive parallelism and why the latter is excluded; (5) the naming/intent of the seven experimental groups (G_plan/G_scaffold/...).
【Must-read】Focus on the formal semantics and verifiability: (1) SGH execution semantics—DAG constraints, node state machine, plan versioning, and layer interfaces; (2) termination/soundness proofs and the engineering meaning of the fairness assumptions; (3) the recovery escalation protocol and how it bounds retries/replanning compared to Agent Loops; (4) the explicit trade-off discussion (controllability vs expressiveness vs implementability), especially the rationale for excluding competitive parallelism/recursion/rollback; (5) the experimental protocol design—how each group changes one factor to support causal attribution when reading tables/figures.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that Agent Loop failures are fundamentally structural rather than merely prompt/model issues: control flow and recovery semantics need explicit, inspectable commitments. A scheduler-theoretic framing enables principled comparison, and SGH operationalizes this via immutable, layered, DAG-based execution with bounded recovery.

recommendation.zh: 把“agent loop”当调度问题重述，能逼你把隐式控制流显式化；只看从 loop 到结构图的转换与有界重试语义，够你改执行器。
recommendation.en: Reframes agent loops as a scheduling problem, forcing implicit control flow to become explicit; skim the loop→graph transformation and bounded-retry semantics—actionable for executor redesign.
